We show that the discretised spin structures on a spin surface naturally recover the signs needed to recover the R/NS sectors. We propose that the collection of OPE coefficients of the discretised 2d CFT can be naturally interpreted as a state-sum of spin-TQFTs, analogous to the bosonic case. This work provides analytically computed starting points for tensor network simulations of fermionic critical phenomena.
summary:
我们扩展了 Cheng 等人的精确定点张量构造。费米子最小模型，为费米子有理共形场论提供定点张量的解析构造。费米子定点张量被定义为三角形上边界变化算子的相关函数，并仔细处理费米子宇称和自旋结构。边界张量也被构造并与三角形张量组合以形成条带，从而能够提取边界改变算子的缩放维度。该结构结合了可收缩边界条件的修改权重、自旋结构的系统描述、恢复了 Neveu-Schwarz 扇区和 Ramond 扇区。作为基准，我们的张量对后代能级进行最小截断，可以收敛到自由马约拉纳费米子的许多低能态的精确体尺度尺寸 ($c=1/2$)，证明了边界变化算子的近似定点张量的效率。

我们还利用基于有理玻色子 CFT 费米子化的费米子 CFT 的更一般描述，并利用它们与模张量类别的连接为离散化制定通用处方。我们表明，自旋表面上的离散自旋结构自然地恢复了恢复 R/NS 扇区所需的符号。我们建议离散 2d CFT 的 OPE 系数的集合可以自然地解释为自旋 TQFT 的状态和，类似于玻色子情况。这项工作为费米子临界现象的张量网络模拟提供了分析计算的起点。

title: Critical Slowing Down and the Crossover to Quantum Scrambling in Holographic CFTs
abstract: We investigate critical relaxation dynamics and their connection to quantum information scrambling in the conformal field theory dual to a Reissner-Nordström anti-de Sitter (RN-AdS) black hole. Employing the holographic dictionary, we formulate the thermodynamics in terms of boundary CFT variables and study the stochastic evolution of the reduced horizon radius using Langevin and Fokker-Planck formalisms. We demonstrate pronounced critical slowing down in the dual CFT, characterized by an enhancement of the autocorrelation time and stochastic fluctuations, accompanied by a suppression of the lowest nonzero Fokker-Planck eigenvalue. The autocorrelation time exhibits a universal power-law divergence, $\tau\sim|\epsilon|^{-\Delta}$, with $\Delta\simeq 2/3$, consistent with the analytical prediction and previous bulk gravitational results. Going beyond the conventional single-parameter analysis, we incorporate variations of the CFT central charge and identify a combined scaling variable involving temperature and central charge, demonstrating that the leading relaxation dynamics retain the same critical exponent along different trajectories in the two-dimensional parameter space. Finally, we explore the interplay between thermodynamic relaxation and quantum information scrambling by comparing the relaxation timescale with the fast-scrambling timescale. The comparison reveals a crossover between thermodynamic relaxation and quantum scrambling for which we derive the corresponding crossover scale analytically and find that, in the large-central-charge limit, it behaves as $\hat{\epsilon}\sim(C\ln C)^{-3/2}$. We also verify this numerically using the full nonlinear free-energy landscape. Our results connect critical dynamical scaling, finite-central-charge effects, and quantum scrambling within the holographic CFT framework.
summary:
我们研究了临界弛豫动力学及其与 Reissner-Nordström 反德西特 (RN-AdS) 黑洞共形场论中量子信息扰乱的联系。利用全息字典，我们根据边界 CFT 变量制定热力学，并使用 Langevin 和 Fokker-Planck 形式研究缩小视界半径的随机演化。我们证明了双 CFT 中明显的临界减速，其特征是自相关时间和随机波动的增强，同时伴随着最低非零 Fokker-Planck 特征值的抑制。自相关时间表现出普遍的幂律发散，$\tau\sim|\epsilon|^{-\Delta}$，其中$\Delta\simeq 2/3$，与分析预测和先前的整体引力结果一致。超越传统的单参数分析，我们结合了 CFT 中心电荷的变化，并确定了涉及温度和中心电荷的组合标度变量，证明领先的弛豫动力学沿二维参数空间中的不同轨迹保留相同的临界指数。

最后，我们通过比较弛豫时间尺度与快速置乱时间尺度来探索热力学弛豫和量子信息置乱之间的相互作用。比较揭示了热力学弛豫和量子扰乱之间的交叉，我们通过分析推导了相应的交叉尺度，并发现在大中心电荷极限下，它的行为为 $\hat{\epsilon}\sim(C\ln C)^{-3/2}$。我们还使用完整的非线性自由能景观在数值上验证了这一点。我们的结果将关键动态标度、有限中心电荷效应和全息 CFT 框架内的量子扰乱联系起来。

title: Proof of the QNEC, without assumptions and under a weight
abstract: We complete a proof of the quantum null energy condition (QNEC) in the mathematical framework of Half-Sided Translations and Modular Inclusions (HST/HSMI) removing an assumption that applied to previous proofs. Here we establish a theorem, which when translated to a physical setting implies that the relative entropy comparing the state of fields outside a stationary black hole with a Hartle-Hawking (HH) state is always a convex function of the horizon cut. Previous proofs only applied when a purification with finite null energy was available. We also obtain a QNEC generalization in which the HH Hilbert space is replaced with one based on a weight which is plausibly of relevance to evaporating black holes in flat space.
summary: 我们在半边平移和模包含 (HST/HSMI) 的数学框架中完成了量子零能量条件 (QNEC) 的证明，消除了应用于先前证明的假设。在这里，我们建立了一个定理，当转化为物理环境时，意味着将静止黑洞外部场的状态与哈特尔-霍金（HH）状态进行比较的相对熵始终是视界切割的凸函数。以前的证明仅适用于具有有限零能量的净化可用的情况。我们还获得了 QNEC 推广，其中 HH 希尔伯特空间被基于权重的空间所取代，该权重似乎与平坦空间中蒸发的黑洞相关。

title: Semiclassical Asymptotics of Entanglement in Torus-Link States
abstract: We investigate the entanglement entropy of topological quantum states associated with $T_{d,\,dn}$ torus links in (2+1)-dimensional SU(2) Chern--Simons theory at level $k$. These links consist of $d$ components with pairwise linking number $n$, and the corresponding link-complement states provide a natural setting to study multipartite entanglement in topological quantum field theories. We analyze the semiclassical limit $k\to\infty$ of the entanglement entropy by deriving the asymptotic behavior of the moments of the reduced density matrix. To achieve this, we decompose the integrable-representation space into left-edge, right-edge, and bulk regions and employ the stationary-phase method to evaluate their respective contributions. We find that the leading asymptotic behavior is governed entirely by the two edge regions, while the bulk contribution is asymptotically suppressed. The resulting expression for the limiting entanglement entropy is given in terms of Hurwitz zeta functions and exhibits a dependence on the residue class of $k$ modulo $n$. We further investigate the dependence of the limiting entanglement entropy on the winding parameter $n$ and the number of link components $d$. In the large-$d$ limit, the entropy reduces to a binary entropy determined by two normalized weights associated with the left and right edges. Finally, we show that the two iterated limits, $k\to\infty$ and $d\to\infty$, commute, reproducing the result obtained previously by taking the large-party limit first.
summary:
我们研究了 (2+1) 维 SU(2) Chern-Simons 理论中 $k$ 级与 $T_{d,\,dn}$ 环面链接相关的拓扑量子态的纠缠熵。这些链接由 $d$ 组件和成对链接数 $n$ 组成，相应的链接互补状态为研究拓扑量子场论中的多部分纠缠提供了自然的设置。我们通过推导约化密度矩阵矩的渐近行为来分析纠缠熵的半经典极限 $k\to\infty$。为了实现这一目标，我们将可积表示空间分解为左边缘、右边缘和体区域，并采用固定相方法来评估它们各自的贡献。我们发现主要的渐近行为完全由两个边缘区域控制，而大部分贡献被渐近抑制。极限纠缠熵的结果表达式以 Hurwitz zeta 函数的形式给出，并表现出对 $k$ 模 $n$ 的残基类别的依赖性。

我们进一步研究了极限纠缠熵对缠绕参数 $n$ 和链接组件数量 $d$ 的依赖性。在大 $d$ 限制中，熵减少为由与左边缘和右边缘相关的两个归一化权重确定的二元熵。最后，我们展示了两个迭代极限，$k\to\infty$ 和 $d\to\infty$，可交换，再现之前通过首先采用大方极限而获得的结果。

title: Matrix-vector models for the 3D Ising CFT
abstract: The construction of three-dimensional conformal field theories (3D CFTs) using interacting fermions in the lowest Landau level on a sphere has recently proven remarkably efficient, while it differs from that of conventional field theories on the fuzzy sphere. Focusing on the 3D Ising CFT, we consider a class of models that are defined by deformed Hamiltonians specified by a function which controls how the interaction is damped at high angular momenta, and this class includes the original model. We show that each model in the class can be reformulated in a basis-independent manner as a matrix--vector quantum-mechanical model, and, upon integrating out the fermionic vectors, as a matrix model. We then focus on a Gaussian choice, for which the bosonic matrices acquire a heat-kernel propagator whose width is controlled by a parameter $\xi$. Through exact diagonalization with the number of fermions up to $16$, we find that the low-energy spectra of the deformed Hamiltonians at criticality agree with those in the 3D Ising CFT for a range of $\xi$. We thus obtain matrix-model realizations of the 3D Ising CFT that, in contrast to conventional fuzzy-sphere field theories, show no sign of UV/IR mixing in the low-lying spectrum.
summary:
最近证明，使用球体最低朗道能级中相互作用的费米子构建三维共形场论（3D CFT）非常有效，但它与模糊球体上的传统场论不同。着眼于 3D Ising CFT，我们考虑一类由变形哈密顿量定义的模型，该变形哈密顿量由控制高角动量下如何阻尼相互作用的函数指定，并且此类包括原始模型。我们表明，该类中的每个模型都可以以与基无关的方式重新表示为矩阵矢量量子力学模型，并且在积分费米子矢量后，重新表示为矩阵模型。然后我们关注高斯选择，为此玻色子矩阵获得一个热核传播器，其宽度由参数 $\xi$ 控制。通过对高达 $16$ 的费米子数量进行精确对角化，我们发现临界变形哈密顿量的低能谱与 3D Ising CFT 中的低能谱在 $\xi$ 范围内一致。

因此，我们获得了 3D Ising CFT 的矩阵模型实现，与传统的模糊球场理论相比，它在低位光谱中没有显示出 UV/IR 混合的迹象。

title: Two-Loop $n$-Point Identical Helicity Amplitude for Gravity Minimally Coupled to a Chiral Fermion
abstract: Motivated by recent developments in the two-loop identical-helicity sector of gauge theory when the one-loop self-dual integrability anomaly of Bardeen and Cangemi, or the equivalent twistor-space version of Costello and Paquette, vanishes, we compute the two-loop four-point identical-helicity amplitude in gravity coupled to a single chiral fermion, for which the corresponding self-dual anomaly also vanishes. We show that the infrared-subtracted amplitude is purely rational and proportional to the identical-helicity tree amplitude of pure gravity with a single insertion of the operator $R^3$. Using this connection, we obtain a closed-form expression for the two-loop $n$-point identical-helicity amplitude in gravity minimally coupled to a fermion. We do so by first obtaining the corresponding identical-helicity gauge-theory tree amplitude with a single $F^3$ insertion using a chiral bootstrap. We then convert these $n$-point gauge theory amplitudes using Kawai-Lewellen-Tye to obtain gravity amplitudes with an $R^3$ insertion, which are necessarily equal to the desired two-loop identical helicity amplitudes of gravity coupled to a chiral fermion. As a nontrivial check, we explicitly verify crossing symmetry and the expected soft limits of our expressions through 13 points.
summary:
受规范理论双环同螺旋领域最新发展的启发，当 Bardeen 和 Cangemi 的单环自对偶可积异常，或 Costello 和 Paquette 的等效扭量空间版本消失时，我们计算了与单个手性费米子耦合的双环四点同螺旋振幅，相应的自对偶异常也消失了。我们证明，通过单次插入算子 $R^3$，红外减去振幅是纯有理数，并且与纯重力的同螺旋树振幅成正比。利用这种联系，我们获得了与费米子最小耦合的重力中的两环 $n$ 点同螺旋振幅的闭合形式表达式。为此，我们首先使用手性引导程序通过单个 $F^3$ 插入获得相应的相同螺旋度规范理论树振幅。然后，我们使用 Kawai-Lewellen-Tye 转换这些 $n$ 点规范理论振幅，以获得具有 $R^3$ 插入的重力振幅，这必然等于与手性费米子耦合的所需的两环相同重力螺旋度振幅。

作为一项重要的检查，我们通过 13 个点明确验证交叉对称性和表达式的预期软限制。

title: Rotating the Replica: Twisted Rényi Coefficients from CFT Operator Counting
abstract: We show that twisting vacuum Rényi entropies by a spatial rotation reveals conformal field theory data governing the asymptotic counting of spinning operators. For a ball in four dimensions, the logarithmic coefficients of these angular-momentum-twisted Rényi entropies are determined by rotating-sphere thermal data to all orders in the local derivative expansion, including the Weyl-anomaly contribution. We test this relation in free theories and in strongly coupled, large-$N$ $\mathcal N=4$ Yang--Mills theory using holography.
summary: 我们证明，通过空间旋转扭曲真空 Rényi 熵揭示了控制旋转算子渐近计数的共形场论数据。对于四个维度的球，这些角动量扭曲 Rényi 熵的对数系数由局部导数展开中所有阶的旋转球体热数据确定，包括 Weyl 异常贡献。我们使用全息术在自由理论和强耦合大$N$\mathcal N=4$ Yang--Mills 理论中测试了这种关系。

title: Einstein--Yang--Mills Plane Waves: Uniqueness and an Exact Curvature Double Copy
abstract: Coleman found plane waves of Yang--Mills theory that are genuinely non-abelian in four dimensions and yet obey linear field equations, and Güven showed that they remain exact when gravity is included. We study these waves in $D$ dimensions. Coleman's profile, which is linear in the transverse coordinates, is singled out twice: up to gauge, it is the only profile with bounded energy density, and the only one for which the full Riemann tensor equals the color-contracted square of the Yang--Mills field strength that sources it. In anti-de Sitter space, we construct a closed-form family for every $D\geq4$; there, the full Riemann tensor cannot equal this color square. Waves whose transverse space is a sphere are always singular. In quadratic and Gauss--Bonnet gravity, a hyperbolic transverse space avoids this only if the waves defocus light or the higher-curvature terms become comparable to the Einstein term. All solutions extend, with changed coefficients, to generic gravity and gauge theories.
summary: 科尔曼发现杨-米尔斯理论的平面波在四个维度上确实是非阿贝尔的，但仍服从线性场方程，而古文表明，当包括重力时，它们仍然是精确的。我们以 $D$ 维度研究这些波浪。科尔曼剖面在横坐标上是线性的，被挑选出来两次：在规范范围内，它是唯一具有有界能量密度的剖面，也是唯一一个完整的黎曼张量等于其来源的杨-米尔斯场强的色收缩平方的剖面。在反德西特空间中，我们为每个$D\geq4$构建一个封闭形式族；在那里，完整的黎曼张量不能等于这个颜色平方。横向空间为球体的波总是奇异的。在二次引力和高斯-邦尼特引力中，只有当波使光散焦或更高曲率项变得与爱因斯坦项相当时，双曲横向空间才能避免这种情况。所有解决方案都通过改变系数扩展到通用重力和规范理论。

title: Zeta function in Coulomb background
abstract: We calculate the one-loop vacuum energy of a massive scalar field confined to the interior of a sphere with Dirichlet boundary conditions and subject to a Coulomb background potential $\alpha/r$. The spectrum is determined by the zeros of a confluent hypergeometric (Kummer) function, and the corresponding zeta function is constructed and analytically continued to $s=-1/2$. The renormalization is performed by subtracting the divergent part of the zeta function, defined through the heat kernel expansion, which removes the non-decreasing powers of the mass and leaves a finite, physically normalized vacuum energy. While the heat kernel coefficients for the pure Bessel (Coulomb-free) case are well known, the Coulomb contributions to the coefficients are not; we determine them by matching the analytic continuation of the zeta function to the general form of the divergent part, obtaining terms proportional to $\alpha$ and $\alpha^2$. A key technical point is that the uniform asymptotic expansion of the mode generating function cannot be used in full; a part must be retained unexpanded, and an integral representation of the digamma function is used to carry out the analytic continuation. In the infinite-volume limit the renormalized vacuum energy tends to a constant $E_0^{ren,\infty}(\alpha,m)=\alpha e(\alpha/m)$, with a dimensionless function $e$ that depends only on the ratio $\al/m$. This limit shows that a finite, physically meaningful renormalized vacuum energy can be defined for a massive scalar field in the background of a Coulomb source. For $m\to\infty$ it vanishes in accordance with the normalization condition, while for $m\to0$ it diverges, so that the present calculation does not apply to a massless field, pointing to the need of another vacuum state in that case.
summary:
我们计算了限制在具有狄利克雷边界条件的球体内部并受库仑背景势 $\alpha/r$ 影响的巨大标量场的单环真空能。光谱由汇合超几何 (Kummer) 函数的零点确定，并构造相应的 zeta 函数并分析继续到 $s=-1/2$。重整化是通过减去通过热核膨胀定义的 zeta 函数的发散部分来执行的，这消除了质量的非递减幂并留下有限的、物理标准化的真空能量。虽然纯贝塞尔（无库仑）情况的热核系数是众所周知的，但库仑对系数的贡献却不是众所周知；我们通过将 zeta 函数的解析延拓与发散部分的一般形式进行匹配来确定它们，获得与 $\alpha$ 和 $\alpha^2$ 成比例的项。一个关键的技术点是模态生成函数的一致渐近展开不能完全利用；一部分必须保持不展开，并且使用双伽玛函数的积分表示来执行解析延拓。

在无限体积极限下，重正化真空能量趋向于常数 $E_0^{ren,\infty}(\alpha,m)=\alpha e(\alpha/m)$，无量纲函数 $e$ 仅取决于比率 $\al/m$。该极限表明，可以为库仑源背景下的大标量场定义有限的、具有物理意义的重正化真空能量。对于$m\to\infty$，它根据归一化条件消失，而对于$m\to0$，它发散，因此当前的计算不适用于无质量场，表明在这种情况下需要另一个真空状态。

title: On a soliton with a non-normalisable zero mode
abstract: We consider the holomorphic baby Skyrme model, which we propose as a simple tractable example of a soliton with a non-normalisable zero mode. The $1$-soliton has the same structure as a lump of fixed size. The size modulus of the sigma model becomes massive, while the phase modulus remains massless. The latter is non-normalisable in the $(0+1)$-dimensional sense because of the soliton tail. A suitable way to treat it is to consider the radial $(1+1)$-dimensional effective action on the half-plane. The soliton core sets the boundary condition for the effective model, which we evaluate with the WKB approximation and also numerically. We discuss the analogue of the effective moduli space approximation with a $1+1$ model and a boundary term at a certain cutoff scale. This may serve as a prototype for more complex systems featuring non-normalisable zero modes such as certain kinds of monopoles in $3+1$ dimensions.
summary: 我们考虑全纯婴儿 Skyrme 模型，我们将其作为具有不可归一化零模式的孤子的简单易处理示例。 $1$孤子具有与固定大小的块相同的结构。西格玛模型的尺寸模量变得巨大，而相位模量保持无质量。由于孤子尾部，后者在 $(0+1)$ 维意义上是不可归一化的。处理它的合适方法是考虑半平面上的径向 $(1+1)$ 维有效作用。孤子核心设置了有效模型的边界条件，我们使用 WKB 近似和数值对其进行评估。我们讨论了有效模空间近似与 $1+1$ 模型和特定截止尺度的边界项的类比。这可以作为具有不可归一化零模式的更复杂系统的原型，例如 $3+1$ 维度中的某些类型的单极子。

title: First-order origins of second-order supersymmetry
abstract: One-dimensional second-order supersymmetry is constructed from conserved first-order operators on a surface with a cyclic coordinate. In Witten's mechanics with two fermionic modes, a centrally extended $N=4$ algebra permits a conserved product connecting the zero- and two-fermion sectors. Cyclic reduction gives the second-order supercharge and the correlated quantum corrections in the charge and partner Hamiltonians. Isothermal coordinates identify the auxiliary Hill equation with the separated Laplace or wave equation for the gauge-transformed charge kernel, and express the correction as a Schwarzian derivative. The central momentum fixes the quadratic invariant $C$: the Riemannian construction gives $C\leq0$, and its indefinite counterpart gives $C\geq0$, with a separately chosen positive adjoint after reduction. Diagonalizing the one-fermion intermediate recovers real scalar factorizations for $C\leq0$ and complex ones for $C>0$. Pauli reductions provide a second first-order mechanism; on the hyperbolic plane they reveal a curvature-dependent invariant and additional charges of a regular free-particle--Pöschl--Teller pair in a selected momentum sector. In one dimension, a formally Hermitian two-component intermediate with a positive inner product yields local first-order chains for arbitrary $C$. For a constant superpotential, a real transverse deformation on a flat cylinder also gives a first-order surface realization of $C>0$ with a positive inner product.
summary:
一维二阶超对称性是由具有循环坐标的表面上的保守一阶算子构造的。在具有两种费米子模式的维滕力学中，中心扩展的 $N=4$ 代数允许连接零费米子扇区和两个费米子扇区的守恒积。循环还原给出了二阶增压以及电荷和伙伴哈密顿量中的相关量子校正。等温坐标将辅助希尔方程与规范变换电荷核的分离拉普拉斯或波动方程识别，并将校正表示为施瓦茨导数。中心动量固定了二次不变量 $C$：黎曼构造给出 $C\leq0$，其不定对应给出 $C\geq0$，并在约简后单独选择正伴随。对一费米子中间体进行对角化可恢复 $C\leq0$ 的实标量分解和 $C>0$ 的复数分解。泡利约简提供了第二个一阶机制；在双曲平面上，它们揭示了选定动量扇区中规则自由粒子-Pöschl-Teller 对的曲率相关不变量和附加电荷。

在一个维度中，具有正内积的形式厄米特二元中间体会产生任意 $C$ 的局部一阶链。对于恒定的超势，扁平圆柱体上的实际横向变形也给出了 $C>0$ 的一阶表面实现，且具有正内积。

title: Cubic Curvature Corrections to Taub-NUT-AdS Black Holes and Their Thermodynamics
abstract: We investigate cubic curvature corrections to four-dimensional Taub-NUT-AdS black holes and their thermodynamics. We construct the complete analytic solution to the first order in the higher-derivative couplings, and derive the corrected Hawking temperature and Wald entropy. The NUT potential remains unchanged, while reconstructing the NUT charge and Gibbs free energy through the Maxwell relation leaves just one undetermined function of the NUT parameter. We then independently evaluate the Gibbs free energy using two improved Reall-Santos methods, based on either the field redefinition or the background subtraction. After matching the thermodynamic variables, both methods yield identical results and fix the undetermined function, providing a consistent determination of the mass and NUT charge. Our work therefore establishes that the thermodynamics of Taub-NUT-AdS black hole withstands the higher-derivative corrections.
summary: 我们研究了四维 Taub-NUT-AdS 黑洞的立方曲率修正及其热力学。我们构造了高导数耦合中一阶的完整解析解，并推导了校正的霍金温度和沃尔德熵。 NUT 电势保持不变，而通过麦克斯韦关系重建 NUT 电荷和吉布斯自由能，仅留下 NUT 参数的一个未确定函数。然后，我们基于场重新定义或背景扣除，使用两种改进的 Reall-Santos 方法独立评估吉布斯自由能。匹配热力学变量后，两种方法都会产生相同的结果并修复未确定的函数，从而提供质量和 NUT 电荷的一致确定。因此，我们的工作证明 Taub-NUT-AdS 黑洞的热力学能够承受更高的导数修正。

title: Deep Inelastic Scattering and Proton Structure Functions in AdS/QCD models
abstract: In this work we study the holographical fermionic deep inelastic scattering in a deformed AdS model. Imposing that the potentials that emerge from the Schrödinger-like equations for the fermionic chiral left and right modes are SUSY partners to preserve isospectrality, we implement a systematical truncation of such potentials. Then, we show that in the quadratic approximation of the deformed AdS model, the fermionic DIS and the proton structure functions $F_{1,2}(q^2,x)$ are identical with the results obtained from the soft wall model. Further, we obtain and compare high-order approximations for the fermionic potentials with the full solution of the deformed AdS model and show, as expected, that as greater the order of approximation, the better are the results for $F_{1,2}(q^2,x)$ when compared with experimental data explicitly for the Bjorken parameter values $x=0.85, 0.75$ and $0.65$.
summary: 在这项工作中，我们研究了变形 AdS 模型中的全息费米子深层非弹性散射。假设从费米子手征左模和右模的类薛定谔方程中出现的势是保持同谱性的 SUSY 伙伴，我们对这些势进行了系统的截断。然后，我们表明，在变形 AdS 模型的二次近似中，费米子 DIS 和质子结构函数 $F_{1,2}(q^2,x)$ 与软壁模型获得的结果相同。此外，我们获得了费米子势的高阶近似值，并将其与变形 AdS 模型的完整解进行了比较，结果表明，正如预期的那样，近似阶数越大，与 Bjorken 参数值 $x=0.85、0.75$ 和 $0.65$ 的实验数据相比，$F_{1,2}(q^2,x)$ 的结果就越好。

title: On Thermodynamic Role of the Gauss-Bonnet Topological Term
abstract: We revisit the thermodynamic implications of the Gauss-Bonnet topological term in four spacetime dimensions. It has been previously claimed in the literature that this term, although it does not modify the equations of motion, shifts the black hole entropy by a contribution proportional to the Euler characteristic of the horizon. We argue that this conclusion is sensitive to the choice of the boundary action on the horizon. We then identify a choice for which the Wald entropy expression naturally reproduces the Jacobson-Myers entropy, even for non-stationary black holes. We also show that there are no further contributions to conserved quantities from smooth outer boundaries, regardless of the choice of boundary conditions there and of the asymptotic behaviour of the spacetime. Moreover, we demonstrate that the topological Gauss-Bonnet term changes the critical temperature of the Hawking-Page phase transition, opening, in principle, a way for detecting its presence in the gravitational action. In fact, for a positive Gauss-Bonnet coupling constant, we observe a zeroth-order Hawking phase transition at high temperatures and pressures. While our discussion focuses on the case of the Gauss-Bonnet term in 4D, the results are more general and qualitatively apply to other Lovelock Lagrangians in their respective critical dimensions.
summary:
我们重新审视四个时空维度中高斯-博内拓扑项的热力学含义。之前的文献曾声称，该术语虽然不修改运动方程，但会通过与视界的欧拉特征成比例的贡献来改变黑洞熵。我们认为这个结论对地平线上边界作用的选择很敏感。然后，我们确定了一个选择，即使对于非平稳黑洞，沃尔德熵表达式也能自然地再现雅各布森-迈尔斯熵。我们还表明，无论边界条件的选择以及时空的渐近行为如何，光滑外边界对守恒量都没有进一步的贡献。此外，我们证明了拓扑高斯-邦尼项改变了霍金-佩奇相变的临界温度，原则上开辟了一种检测其在引力作用中存在的方法。事实上，对于正的高斯-博内耦合常数，我们在高温和高压下观察到零级霍金相变。

虽然我们的讨论重点是 4D 中高斯-博内特项的情况，但结果更加普遍，并且定性地适用于其他洛夫洛克拉格朗日量在各自的临界维度上。

title: Boundary Formula for Volume Response of Entanglement Wedge Polygons
abstract: The vacuum volume of an entanglement wedge polygon is topological. We determine its semiclassical quadratic response to time-symmetric coherent scalar matter in AdS$_3$. A contrast of six interval entropies measures a nonnegatively weighted energy integral, whereas volume depends on the unweighted integral. For negative mass squared above the stability bound, perturbations with the same quadratic coefficient of global energy can match all six vacuum entropies through second order yet have opposite volume responses. A continuum of narrowing quartets reconstructs the volume response with controlled noise. An independent CFT calculation for a dimension-$3/2$ primary reproduces an exact polygon edge formula.
summary: 纠缠楔形多边形的真空体积是拓扑的。我们确定了它对 AdS$_3$ 中时间对称相干标量物质的半经典二次响应。六个区间熵的对比测量非负加权能量积分，而体积取决于未加权积分。对于高于稳定界限的负质量平方，具有相同全局能量二次系数的扰动可以通过二阶匹配所有六个真空熵，但具有相反的体积响应。一系列缩小的四重奏通过受控噪声重建了音量响应。对维度 $3/2$ 初级的独立 CFT 计算可重现精确的多边形边缘公式。

title: M-theory anomaly localization and holographic $c$-extremization
abstract: We compute the cubic and $C_3\wedge X_8$ caracteristic class contributions to the trial anomaly polynomial of supersymmetric $AdS_3\times M_8$ backgrounds with $M_8=P(\mathcal O \oplus \mathcal L)\to B_6$. Including the Abelian currents descending from $C_3$, we identify the projective invariant $J$ as the denominator arising from their elimination by $c$-extremization and recover the central charge $c^{(0)}=-I_3+3I_+I_-/J$. The $X_8$ push-forward determines the pure R-symmetry, mixed R--Betti and gravitational anomalies. Evaluating it at the classical extremum gives the associated central-charge corrections, linear in the overall unshifted flux. The mixed term contributes equally to both central charges and is required in general. We evaluate these formulae for three flux-quantized backgrounds, including non-polynomial solutions. Direct projective fibre integration reproduces the mixed coefficient obtained by localization. On the wrapped-$M5$ $S^4$ bundle, the same couplings reproduce the independently known field-theory anomaly through orders $N^3$ and $N$. Their interpretation as full CFT central charges requires a unitary SCFT with a normalizable vacuum, suitable supersymmetric boundary conditions, a complete mixing sector of global currents and control of omitted anomaly sectors. A conditional Euclidean relative-equivariant interpretation is discussed separately.
summary:
我们计算立方和 $C_3\wedge X_8$ 特征类对超对称 $AdS_3\times M_8$ 背景的试验异常多项式的贡献，其中 $M_8=P(\mathcal O \oplus \mathcal L)\to B_6$。包括从$C_3$下降的阿贝尔电流，我们将射影不变量$J$确定为通过$c$-极值化消除它们而产生的分母，并恢复中心电荷$c^{(0)}=-I_3+3I_+I_-/J$。 $X_8$ 前推决定了纯 R 对称性、混合 R--Betti 和引力异常。在经典极值处对其进行评估会给出相关的中心电荷校正，与整体未移动通量呈线性关系。混合项对两个中心费用的贡献相等，并且通常是必需的。我们针对三个通量量化背景（包括非多项式解）评估这些公式。直接投影光纤积分再现了通过定位获得的混合系数。在包裹的 $M5$ $S^4$ 束上，相同的耦合通过 $N^3$ 和 $N$ 阶次再现独立已知的场论异常。

他们将其解释为完整的 CFT 中心电荷，需要具有可归一化真空、合适的超对称边界条件、全局电流的完整混合扇区以及对遗漏异常扇区的控制的单一 SCFT。条件欧几里得相对等变解释将单独讨论。

title: Global Green-Schwarz response on quaternionic sphere bundles
abstract: Local anomaly polynomials describe local variations, but a normalized Green-Schwarz phase also depends on global background data. We explain this dependence for ten-dimensional three-sphere bundles of quaternionic lines over closed spin seven-manifolds. The backgrounds retain two specified $\mathrm{Spin}(16)$ gauge bundles and an integral differential trivialization on the base, including its boundary identifications. The trivialized class is the sum of half the first Pontryagin class of the tangent bundle and the second Chern class of the quaternionic line's underlying complex bundle. For these backgrounds, the calculation combines a generally nonzero local Green-Schwarz integral with a real eta invariant evaluated by a twelve-dimensional Atiyah-Patodi-Singer filling. Together, these terms determine an integral relative characteristic number; the additive response is one third of that number, modulo integers. When the base's third and fourth rational cohomology groups vanish, the response equals eight times the Crowley-Goette invariant, without assuming that the base is simply connected. A calibration using the actual quaternionic line bundle gives additive value one third on $\mathrm{Sp}(2)$, recovering the known third-root phase. Distinct integral String data on one fixed ten-manifold give all three phase values, showing which global background information the response can detect. The physical identifications retain their prescribed fermion data, while the separate application to integral topological modular forms and vertex operator superalgebras requires compatible integral lifts. The response calculation constructs neither a microscopic realization nor an equivalence of complete theories.
summary:
局部异常多项式描述局部变化，但归一化格林-施瓦茨相位也取决于全局背景数据。我们解释了十维三球四元线束在闭自旋七流形上的这种依赖性。背景保留两个指定的 $\mathrm{Spin}(16)$ 规范束和基础上的积分微分平凡化，包括其边界标识。平凡化类是切丛的第一 Pontryagin 类和四元数线的底层复丛的第二 Chern 类的一半之和。对于这些背景，计算将一般非零的局部 Green-Schwarz 积分与通过十二维 Atiyah-Patodi-Singer 填充评估的实 eta 不变量相结合。这些术语共同决定了一个完整的相对特征数；加性响应是该数字的三分之一，模整数。当基的第三和第四有理上同调群消失时，响应等于 Crowley-Goette 不变量的八倍，而不假设基是单连通的。

使用实际四元线束的校准给出了 $\mathrm{Sp}(2)$ 上的三分之一的附加值，恢复了已知的三次方根相位。一个固定的十流形上的不同积分字符串数据给出所有三个相位值，显示响应可以检测到哪些全局背景信息。物理识别保留其规定的费米子数据，而积分拓扑模形式和顶点算子超代数的单独应用需要兼容的积分提升。响应计算既不构建微观实现，也不构建完整理论的等价物。

title: On the Seven-particle Clusters of Lennard-Jones and Thomson
abstract: In this Letter, we develop a graph-geometric framework and prove that the pentagonal bipyramid (PBP) is the unique global minimiser of both the seven-particle Lennard-Jones energy in $\mathbb{R}^3$ and the seven-charge Thomson energy on $S^2$, up to rigid symmetries and particle relabelling. For the Thomson problem, this strengthens a recent deterministic global-optimality certificate to numerical tolerance into an exact global-optimality and uniqueness theorem. A weak-interaction graph, defined by thresholding pair geometry, organises configuration space without imposing symmetry or discarding any pair interaction. For Lennard-Jones, pair-energy counting, graph classification, subset bounds, and force balance reduce all possible minimisers to 29 bounded domains; exact geometric certificates exclude 28, localise the survivor near the PBP, and a uniform restoring-energy estimate proves uniqueness. The Thomson proof follows the same progression: graph reduction, geometric localisation, and rigidity, but finalises through whole-domain coercivity and a global localisation theorem. The same fivefold order therefore emerges in two very different physical settings: an unconstrained cluster with a preferred bond length and purely repelling charges confined to a sphere, showing a common geometric organising principle for seven particles that is not tied to either interaction.
summary:
在这封信中，我们开发了一个图几何框架，并证明五边形双锥体（PBP）是 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中的七粒子 Lennard-Jones 能量和 $S^2$ 上的七电荷汤姆逊能量的唯一全局最小化器，直至刚性对称和粒子重新标记。对于汤姆森问题，这强化了最近的确定性全局最优性证明，将数值容差转化为精确的全局最优性和唯一性定理。通过阈值对几何定义的弱交互图组织配置空间，而不强加对称性或丢弃任何对交互。对于 Lennard-Jones，对能量计数、图分类、子集边界和力平衡将所有可能的极小值减少到 29 个有界域；精确的几何证明排除了 28，将幸存者定位在 PBP 附近，并且统一的恢复能量估计证明了唯一性。汤姆森证明遵循相同的进程：图简化、几何局部化和刚性，但最终通过全域矫顽力和全局局部化定理完成。

因此，相同的五重顺序出现在两种截然不同的物理环境中：具有首选键长和仅限于球体的纯排斥电荷的不受约束的簇，显示了七个粒子的共同几何组织原理，不与任何一种相互作用相关。

title: On transportation of constrictions on phase-lock areas of overdamped Josephson junction by means of isomonodromic deformation of the associated special double confluent Heun equation
abstract: An example of computation of locations of constrictions on the phase-lock area in the parameter space for the equation modeling dynamics of overdamped Josephson junction is discussed. Several conjectures of qualitative character are inferred from the heuristic data thus obtained. The method applying isomonodromic deformations of the special double confluent Heun equation associated with the noted model is used. Such a deformation is controlled by the data provided by solution to a Third Painlevè equation for which a new representation in conjunction with the corresponding non-linear second order differential equation fairly efficient in the treatment of the problem in question is proposed.
summary: 讨论了过阻尼约瑟夫森结动力学方程建模参数空间中锁相区域收缩位置的计算示例。从由此获得的启发式数据推断出一些定性特征的猜想。使用应用与所述模型相关的特殊双合流 Heun 方程的等单向变形的方法。这种变形是由第三 Painlevè 方程的解所提供的数据控制的，为此提出了一种与相应的非线性二阶微分方程相结合的新表示，在处理所讨论的问题时相当有效。

title: Positivity Improving Quantum Markov Operators
abstract: A Markov operator on a matrix algebra, that is, a unital completely positive map, is called positivity improving if it maps every nonzero positive element to an invertible one. This is the noncommutative counterpart of a stochastic matrix with strictly positive entries. We show that positivity improvement is self-dual and equivalent to a faithful quantum Markov--Dobrushin--Doeblin minorization. We also compare the scalar trace minorization with the optimal common-lower-bound construction of the quantum Markov--Dobrushin coefficient. We then characterize positivity improvement through the Kraus space of the map: a Markov operator is positivity improving if and only if the Hilbert--Schmidt orthogonal complement of its Kraus space contains no operator of rank one. As a consequence the Kraus rank of a positivity improving Markov operator on the algebra of $d\times d$ matrices is at least $2d-1$, and an explicit Hankel-type channel shows that this bound is attained in every dimension. Although deciding positivity improvement is NP-hard in general, we obtain complete and effectively checkable classifications for qubits and qutrits, together with families of examples (Pauli, Weyl and Werner--Holevo channels) showing that all our estimates are optimal. Finally we show that, in infinite dimensions, positivity improvement no longer implies any contraction of the Markov operator.
summary:
矩阵代数上的马尔可夫算子，即单位完全正映射，如果将每个非零正元素映射到可逆元素，则称为正性改进。这是具有严格正项的随机矩阵的非交换对应物。我们表明，积极性的提高是自对偶的，相当于忠实的量子马尔可夫-多布鲁辛-多布林少数化。我们还将标量迹少数化与量子马尔可夫-多布鲁辛系数的最佳公共下界结构进行了比较。然后，我们通过映射的克劳斯空间来表征积极性的提高：当且仅当其克劳斯空间的希尔伯特-施密特正交补不包含秩一的算子时，马尔可夫算子才是积极性提高。因此，$d\times d$ 矩阵代数上的正性改进马尔可夫算子的 Kraus 等级至少为 $2d-1$，并且显式 Hankel 型通道表明在每个维度上都达到了这个界限。

虽然决定积极性的改进一般来说是 NP 困难的，但我们获得了完整且有效的可检查的量子位和量子态分类，以及一系列示例（Pauli、Weyl 和 Werner-Holevo 通道），表明我们所有的估计都是最优的。最后我们证明，在无限维度中，积极性的提高不再意味着马尔可夫算子的任何收缩。

title: Geometric classification of Noether invariants of the Time-Dependent damped Duffing Oscillator
abstract: We present a systematic geometric classification of the Noether point symmetries of time-dependent conformal Lagrangians of the form $L = A(t)\left(\frac{1}{2}g_{ij}\dot{x}^{i}\dot{x}^{j} - V(x)\right)$, whose Euler--Lagrange equations describe dynamical systems with time-dependent linear damping. The classification is carried out by coupling the temporal parameters of the conformal factor $A(t)$ with the homothetic algebra of the kinetic metric $g_{ij}$ through a set of compatibility and integrability conditions. The central result is a main theorem which determines the Noether generators, the associated gauge functions and the resulting invariants. The theorem splits naturally into two cases according to whether the quantity $D - 2\psi$ is non-zero or zero, with further subcases depending on whether the homothetic vectors are gradient or non-gradient. The theorem imposes no restrictions on $A(t)$, $g_{ij}$ or $V(x)$, and is therefore fully general and covariant. We apply the theorem to the time-dependent damped Duffing oscillator (DDO) in Euclidean space $E^{3}$ with $A(t) = e^{\gamma t}$ and potential $V = \frac{1}{2}a\,r^{2} + \frac{% \lambda}{4}r^{4}$. For the damped harmonic oscillator ($\lambda = 0$) the theorem reproduces the classical Bateman invariant as a special case. For the anharmonic case we obtain a new exact time-dependent quadratic invariant, valid when the linear stiffness satisfies $a = 2\gamma^{2}/9$. Each invariant is verified explicitly by direct differentiation along the equations of motion. The new invariant provides a rare example of a global conservation law for a fully nonlinear dissipative system, and can be used for the integration and quantization of the DDO.
summary:
我们提出了形式为 $L = A(t)\left(\frac{1}{2}g_{ij}\dot{x}^{i}\dot{x}^{j} - V(x)\right)$ 的随时间共形拉格朗日的诺特点对称性的系统几何分类，其欧拉-拉格朗日方程描述了具有随时间线性阻尼的动力系统。分类是通过一组兼容性和可积性条件将共形因子 $A(t)$ 的时间参数与动力学度量 $g_{ij}$ 的拟似代数耦合来进行的。中心结果是一个主定理，它确定了诺特生成元、相关的规范函数以及由此产生的不变量。根据数量 $D - 2\psi$ 是非零还是零，该定理自然地分为两种情况，进一步的子情况取决于相似向量是梯度还是非梯度。该定理对 $A(t)$、$g_{ij}$ 或 $V(x)$ 没有任何限制，因此是完全通用的和协变的。我们将该定理应用于欧几里得空间 $E^{3}$ 中的瞬态阻尼达芬振子 (DDO)，其中 $A(t) = e^{\gamma t}$ 和势 $V = \frac{1}{2}a\,r^{2} + \frac{% \lambda}{4}r^{4}$。

对于阻尼谐振子 ($\lambda = 0$)，该定理将经典贝特曼不变量再现为特例。对于非调和情况，我们获得了一个新的精确的时间相关二次不变量，当线性刚度满足 $a = 2\gamma^{2}/9$ 时有效。每个不变量都通过运动方程的直接微分来明确验证。新的不变量为完全非线性耗散系统提供了全局守恒定律的罕见示例，并且可用于 DDO 的积分和量化。

title: The random matrix hard edge --- applications, exact PDFs and large $N$ expansions
abstract: A hard edge of a Hermitian random matrix occurs when the eigenvalue density is strictly zero on one side of the edge, and nonzero on the other. Another possibility is that the eigenvalues occur in $\pm$ pairs, which creates a hard edge at the origin for the positive eigenvalues. Both review material and new results are presented for random matrix ensembles exhibiting a hard edge. The review material has two focuses: one is on applications of the random matrix hard edge, while the other is on exact eigenvalue probability density functions. The new results relate to the large $N$ expansion of correlation functions and conditioned gap probability generating functions with hard edge scaling for the Jacobi ensemble. For all even $\beta$ we are able to show that these quantities admit expansions in inverse even powers of the variable $N_{\rm hJ}':= N - 1/2 + (a + b + 1)/\beta$. For the $\beta =2$ Jacobi unitary ensemble, we can relate the leading (next leading) correction to the limit law to a particular second order (fourth order) differential operator applied to the latter. The analogous second order differential operator is found for $\beta=1,4$, leading then to its conjectured form for all $\beta>0$.
summary:
当边缘一侧的特征值密度严格为零且另一侧不为零时，埃尔米特随机矩阵的硬边缘就会出现。另一种可能性是特征值出现在 $\pm$ 对中，这会在正特征值的原点处创建硬边。回顾材料和新结果都针对表现出硬边缘的随机矩阵系综。综述材料有两个重点：一是随机矩阵硬边缘的应用，二是精确特征值概率密度函数。新结果与相关函数和条件间隙概率生成函数的大$N$展开有关，并具有雅可比系综的硬边缘缩放。对于所有偶数 $\beta$，我们能够证明这些量允许变量 $N_{\rm hJ}':= N - 1/2 + (a + b + 1)/\beta$ 的逆偶次幂展开。对于 $\beta =2$ 雅可比酉系综，我们可以将极限定律的前导（次前导）修正与应用于后者的特定二阶（四阶）微分算子联系起来。

对于 $\beta=1,4$ 可以找到类似的二阶微分算子，从而得出所有 $\beta>0$ 的猜想形式。

title: Cylinder spectral curve and 1-cut Matrix model
abstract: For a random matrix, with eigenvalues in a one-body potential $V(x)$ and a 2-body interaction $R(x,x')$, it is known that the resolvent converges in the large $N$ limit to an analytic function in the complex plane minus cuts, called the spectral curve. In the 1-cut case, a two-sheeted neighborhood of the cut is a cylinder with two simple ramification points. We describe these spectral curve data by boundary integral operators and generalized cycles. Vice-versa, given a 2-branchpoints spectral curve in a cylinder, there exists a formal random matrix model that corresponds to it. The goal of this article is to show the method to recover a formal random matrix model, with its potential and 2-body interaction, from the geometry of the spectral curve.
summary: 对于随机矩阵，其特征值为单体势 $V(x)$ 和 2 体相互作用 $R(x,x')$，已知解析函数在大 $N$ 极限下收敛到复平面减去割线中的解析函数，称为谱曲线。在 1 切割情况下，切割的两片邻域是具有两个简单分枝点的圆柱体。我们通过边界积分算子和广义循环来描述这些光谱曲线数据。反之亦然，给定圆柱体中的 2 分支点谱曲线，存在与其对应的形式随机矩阵模型。本文的目标是展示从光谱曲线的几何形状恢复正式随机矩阵模型及其潜在的二体相互作用的方法。

title: Exactly integrable field theory in $(2+1)$-dimensional space-time: the spectral equations
abstract: The primary object in quantum field theories is the one-step relativistic evolution operator. In this paper we consider the evolution operator defined on the auxiliary Kagomé lattice with the $q$-oscillator algebra of observables, the local ingredient of the evolution operator is the $q$-oscillator $R$-matrix of the Zamolodchikov tetrahedron equation. We construct explicitly the complete system of equations (which can be seen as a specific form of nested Bethe Ansatz equations) defining the spectrum of the evolution operator. This system of equations is valid for an arbitrary initial data (occupation numbers), and the thermodynamical limit is well defined for this system.
summary: 量子场论的主要对象是一步相对论演化算子。在本文中，我们考虑用可观测量 $q$-振子代数定义在辅助 Kagomé 格子上的演化算子，演化算子的​​局部成分是 Zamolodchikov 四面体方程的 $q$-振子 $R$-矩阵。我们明确构建了完整的方程组（可以看作嵌套 Bethe Ansatz 方程的特定形式），定义了演化算子的​​谱。该方程组对于任意初始数据（占用数）均有效，并且该系统的热力学极限已明确定义。

title: The Lee-Yang property of the Blume-Emery-Griffiths model
abstract: The Lieb-Sokal theorem provides a tool for establishing the Lee-Yang property of the partition function of a spin model if the corresponding single-spin partition function has this property and the interaction term in its Hamiltonian is of the form $-\sum J_{ij} S_iS_j$ with $J_{ij}\geq 0$. According to the result of this paper, the spin $S=1$ model with the Hamiltonian $-\sum (J_{ij} S_iS_j + K_{ij}S_i^2S_j^2) + \sum \Delta S_i^2$ has the Lee-Yang property for all $K_{ij}\in \mathds{R}$ and $\Delta >0$, whenever each $J_{ij}$ exceeds an explicitly computed bound $C(\beta, \Delta, K_{ij})>0$, such that $C(\beta, \Delta, K_{ij})\to + \infty$ as $\beta \to 0$. The latter suggests that the Lee-Yang property of this model may hold only for sufficiently low temperatures.
summary: Lieb-Sokal 定理提供了一个工具，用于建立自旋模型的配分函数的 Lee-Yang 性质，如果相应的单自旋配分函数具有该性质，并且其哈密顿量中的相互作用项的形式为 $-\sum J_{ij} S_iS_j$ 与 $J_{ij}\geq 0$。根据本文的结果，具有哈密顿量 $-\sum (J_{ij} S_iS_j + K_{ij}S_i^2S_j^2) + \sum \Delta S_i^2$ 的自旋 $S=1$ 模型对于所有 $K_{ij}\in \mathds{R}$ 和 $\Delta >0$ 都具有 Lee-Yang 性质，只要每个 $J_{ij}$ 超过明确计算的界限$C(\beta, \Delta, K_{ij})>0$，使得 $C(\beta, \Delta, K_{ij})\to + \infty$ 作为 $\beta \to 0$。后者表明该模型的李杨性质可能仅在足够低的温度下成立。

title: SU(2) Yang-Mills: Spectral Bounds, Vacuum Concentration, and Criteria for the Continuum Limit
abstract: A continuum mass-gap argument must preserve nonzero renormalized states and a positive spectral estimate while the spatial cutoff is removed and physical volume grows. We develop quantitative results that separate these requirements. Gauge reduction, reflection positivity and attributed strong-coupling estimates give physical-transfer bounds with nontrivial local sectors. At fixed spatial cutoff and positive coupling, we construct subsequential infinite-volume physical-time dynamics from local history correlations, with nonconstant gauge-invariant observables. For finite spatial boxes, explicit bounds apply to the entire physical vacuum complement; finite-matrix criteria include all omitted representations. Vacuum concentration gives extensive entropy bounds, quantitative fidelity obstructions for hard electric cutoffs, and necessary growth of retained representation spaces. A sharper local comparison yields complete bounds on fixed discarded-link sectors, while collective projection and Schur estimates isolate the additional input needed for a volume-uniform gap. The work also certifies a finite three-link conditioning functional through Wilson coupling 0.354, with its physical interpretation conditional on the stated block-comparison hypotheses. Exact blocking, corrected effective-potential theorems and a representation-by-representation two-dimensional benchmark clarify which approximations preserve the relevant observables. Published glueball measurements retain their original attribution; their reanalysis and the reproduced winding-channel and replica studies have explicitly statistical scope. Complete derivations and reproducible calculations support a set of certified benchmarks and continuum transfer criteria. A nontrivial four-dimensional spatial-cutoff construction and a positive spectral bound along it are not established; no exact continuum mass is asserted.
summary:
当空间截止被移除且物理体积增长时，连续质量带隙参数必须保留非零重整化状态和正谱估计。我们开发了区分这些要求的定量结果。规范减少、反射正性和归因的强耦合估计给出了与重要局部部门的物理转移界限。在固定的空间截止和正耦合下，我们从局部历史相关性和非常量规范不变的可观测量中构建了后续的无限体积物理时间动力学。对于有限空间盒，显式边界适用于整个物理真空补集；有限矩阵准则包括所有省略的表示。真空集中提供了广泛的熵界、硬电截止的定量保真度障碍以及保留表示空间的必要增长。更清晰的局部比较产生了固定废弃链路部门的完整界限，而集体预测和舒尔估计则隔离了数量均匀差距所需的额外投入。

这项工作还通过威尔逊耦合 0.354 证明了有限三链接条件泛函，其物理解释以所述块比较假设为条件。精确分块、修正的有效势定理和逐个表示的二维基准阐明了哪些近似保留了相关的可观测值。已发布的胶球测量结果保留其原始归属；他们的重新分析以及重复的缠绕通道和复制品研究具有明确的统计范围。完整的推导和可重复的计算支持一组经过认证的基准和连续传输标准。尚未建立非平凡的四维空间截止结构和沿其的正谱界限；没有断言精确的连续质量。

title: Universal Critical Relations and Nonuniversal Scaling in Inverse-Square Ising Chains
abstract: For ferromagnetic Ising chains with $n^2J_n\to B>0$, the critical excess magnetization in a field inversely proportional to spin separation determines the connected correlation. Their slowly varying profile has finite logarithmic integral exactly when the ordered thermal slope is finite. For any finite nonnegative core, an exact tail gives inverse-logarithmic correlations and a square-root cusp. A relative correction $c/\log(n+e)$ with $c>1$ gives continuously varying logarithmic powers and a linear cusp. A lower bound on its disordered susceptibility excludes the usual Kosterlitz--Thouless law.
summary: 对于 $n^2J_n\to B>0$ 的铁磁 Ising 链，与自旋分离成反比的场中的临界过剩磁化强度决定了相关性。当有序热斜率有限时，它们缓慢变化的轮廓具有有限对数积分。对于任何有限非负核，精确的尾部给出了反对数相关性和平方根尖点。 $c>1$ 的相对校正 $c/\log(n+e)$ 给出连续变化的对数幂和线性尖点。其无序敏感性的下限排除了通常的科斯特利茨-托勒斯定律。

title: Lieb-Robinson bound for one-dimensional continuum fermions
abstract: The central difficulty in quantum many-body physics is that the Hilbert space dimension grows exponentially with the total degrees of freedom. A key feature to circumvent this problem is locality, which manifests dynamically through an approximate causal structure in the form of a Lieb-Robinson bound (LRB). LRBs have been proved for quantum spin systems and certain lattice boson systems, but so far never for realistic continuum systems. We present the first LRB that applies to a standard system of one-dimensional continuum fermions. It applies to initial states with controlled moments of local particle number and energy and is thus thermodynamically stable. Our result breaks the main technical barrier that has existed for using the vast locality toolbox on continuum systems.
summary: 量子多体物理的中心难点是希尔伯特空间维度随着总自由度呈指数增长。规避这个问题的一个关键特征是局部性，它通过李布-罗宾逊界（LRB）形式的近似因果结构动态地体现出来。 LRB 已被证明适用于量子自旋系统和某些晶格玻色子系统，但迄今为止尚未适用于现实的连续介质系统。我们提出了第一个适用于一维连续费米子标准系统的 LRB。它适用于具有受控的局部粒子数和能量矩的初始状态，因此是热力学稳定的。我们的结果打破了在连续系统上使用庞大的局部性工具箱所存在的主要技术障碍。

title: Projective symmetries and differential recursions for the large-$N$ Gross--Witten--Wadia and one-dimensional QCD matrix models
abstract: We compare the fixed-charge planar Gross--Witten--Wadia (GWW) model with source-free one-dimensional QCD at large $N$ and $N_f/N$ fixed. In both models the resolvent and one-cut condition give an algebraic equation for a derivative of the free energy: a quartic for GWW and a sextic for QCD. Finite-$N$ Toeplitz determinants independently check the selected QCD branch. Signed permutations of homogeneous parameter triples realize $S_4$; the resulting action on the algebraic branches and operator labels gives a common projective description of the two models. For QCD, the sextic yields a differential recurrence linking small-charge rows two apart. The same second-order PDE gives a finite-width column recursion that reconstructs the coefficient pyramid from its GWW boundary. A distinct boundary, obtained from the first resummed coefficient, is the Narayana triangle. A formally collapsed slice counts decorated bipartite plane trees and admits an exact symmetric product formula. The many-flavor scaling reduces the sextic to the quartic and retains transverse projective data: the QCD divided-difference triple coalesces at this boundary, whereas the limiting quartic satisfies the full standard GWW third-order system. We distinguish algebraic degree, mixed differential order, and fixed-parameter ordinary differential order throughout.
summary:
我们将固定电荷平面 Gross--Witten--Wadia (GWW) 模型与大 $N$ 和 $N_f/N$ 固定的无源一维 QCD 进行比较。在这两个模型中，解析条件和单割条件给出了自由能导数的代数方程：GWW 的四次方程和 QCD 的六次方程。有限-$N$ Toeplitz 行列式独立检查所选的 QCD 分支。同质参数三元组的有符号排列实现$S_4$；对代数分支和运算符标签产生的作用给出了两个模型的共同投影描述。对于 QCD，六次方程产生将两个分开的小电荷行连接起来的微分递推。相同的二阶 PDE 给出了有限宽度的列递归，该递归从其 GWW 边界重建系数金字塔。从第一个恢复系数获得的明显边界是纳拉亚纳三角形。正式折叠的切片计数装饰的二分梧桐树，并承认精确的对称乘积公式。

多风味缩放将六次简化为四次并保留横向投影数据：QCD 除差三重在此边界处合并，而极限四次满足完整标准 GWW 三阶系统。我们始终区分代数阶、混合微分阶和定参数常微分阶。

title: Transformations of Hilbert Module Reference Frames
abstract: In this paper, we provide a functorial characterization of Hilbert module classical and quantum reference frames. Using the functorial characterization, we construct a category for equivariant couplings and Hilbert module reference frames. We prove the construction of the reference frame system from the equivariant coupling data yields a functor. We also deduce a ``unitary" groupoid as frame transformations for Hilbert module reference frames of a fixed Hilbert module dynamical system. We provide some examples of these frame transformations in the case of the indistinguishable classical two state switch and in the case of Hilbert spaces.
summary: 在本文中，我们提供了希尔伯特模经典和量子参考系的函数表征。使用函子表征，我们构建了等变耦合和希尔伯特模块参考系的类别。我们证明从等变耦合数据构造参考系系统会产生一个函子。我们还推导了一个“酉”群群作为固定希尔伯特模动力系统的希尔伯特模参考系的坐标系变换。我们在不可区分的经典二态切换和希尔伯特空间的情况下提供了这些坐标系变换的一些示例。

title: Certified finite-precision readout for $p$-adic kernel aggregation
abstract: In non-archimedean numerical analysis, a verified $p$-adic approximation can determine an absolute value, and hence downstream probabilistic rankings and classification decisions, with mathematical exactness long before the underlying number is fully resolved. We turn this observation into rigorous finite-precision certificates for norm-based readouts of amplitude families. For a common error radius, a nonempty resolved set already fixes every exact maximizer, ties included, at the sharp integer absolute precision $v_*+1$, and conditioning on that set yields an exact total-variation identity separating unresolved $p$-adic mass from real rounding error. For aggregates of $p$-adic exponentials, we give a centered-moment certificate with an explicit remainder bound: on rational data it runs in exact rational arithmetic without individual exponential evaluations, attains its minimal bound at an active phase, and resolves every nonzero aggregate at high order; we also obtain an aggregate perturbation bound free of summand-count factors. For multiclass $p$-adic classifiers that decode by minimizing the norm of a class discriminant, we prove a necessary and sufficient certification condition and show that the sharp common precision threshold is $v^{(2)}+1$, governed by the second-largest discriminant valuation, so the winning discriminant need not itself be resolved. We apply these certificates to discrete $p$-adic path-integral actions on uniform affine chains, deriving explicit action centers and proving exact output-independence at zero effective quadratic coupling. Pseudocode and a reproducible reference implementation accompany the theory.
summary:
在非阿基米德数值分析中，经过验证的 $p$-adic 近似可以确定绝对值，从而确定下游概率排名和分类决策，早在基本数字完全解析之前就具有数学精确性。我们将这一观察结果转化为严格的有限精度证书，用于基于范数的幅度系列读数。对于常见的误差半径，非空解析集已经以锐整数绝对精度 $v_*+1$ 修复了每个精确的最大化器（包括关系），并且对该集的调节产生了精确的总变分恒等式，将未解析的 $p$-adic 质量与实际舍入误差分开。对于 $p$-adic 指数的聚合，我们给出一个具有显式余数界的中心矩证明：在有理数据上，它以精确有理算术运行，无需单独的指数评估，在活动阶段达到其最小界，并在高阶解析每个非零聚合；我们还获得了一个没有被加数计数因素的聚合扰动界。

对于通过最小化类判别式范数进行解码的多类 $p$-adic 分类器，我们证明了一个必要且充分的证明条件，并表明尖锐的共同精度阈值是 $v^{(2)}+1$，由第二大判别式估值控制，因此获胜判别式本身不需要求解。我们将这些证书应用于均匀仿射链上的离散 $p$-adic 路径积分动作，导出显式动作中心并证明零有效二次耦合时的精确输出独立性。该理论附带伪代码和可重复的参考实现。

title: On transition probabilities for the ASEP on the half-line
abstract: We study the asymmetric simple exclusion process on the half-line with particle insertion and no particle removal at the boundary. We point out that there exist two distinct multiple contour integral formulas for the transition probability between two finite particle configurations containing the same number of particles. We recall one of these formulas from the literature and prove a second, new formula by showing that it satisfies the evolution equation using a coordinate Bethe ansatz calculation and verify that the initial condition is implemented by the contour integrals. As an application we sum this formula over all final configurations and obtain an integral formula for the probability that the number of particles is conserved up to a given time. The proofs use symmetric rational functions and their properties together with contour deformations.
summary: 我们研究了半线上的非对称简单排除过程，在边界处有粒子插入且没有粒子去除。我们指出，对于包含相同数量粒子的两个有限粒子配置之间的转移概率，存在两个不同的多重轮廓积分公式。我们回顾文献中的其中一个公式，并证明第二个新公式，证明它使用坐标 Bethe ansatz 计算满足演化方程，并验证初始条件是由轮廓积分实现的。作为一个应用，我们对所有最终配置求和该公式，并获得粒子数量在给定时间内守恒的概率的积分公式。该证明使用对称有理函数及其性质以及轮廓变形。

title: An Algebraic Foundation of Rate-Product Style Quantity Calculus
abstract: Using the new notion of a scalable (right) monoid-heap, the quantity calculus in [1] is generalized to include quantities that may not be possible to multiply as well as both (weak) rates and products of quantities. Several examples are given of applications in metrology and physics
summary: 使用可扩展（右）幺半群堆的新概念，[1] 中的数量计算被概括为包括可能无法相乘的数量以及数量的（弱）率和乘积。给出了计量学和物理应用的几个例子

title: Real-Time Path Integral Resurgence: Which Classical Path Contributes?
abstract: Which complex classical paths contribute to a real-time Feynman path integral? Picard-Lefschetz theory answers this question with the intersection numbers of the thimbles, which are notoriously hard to compute in infinite dimensions. We show that resurgence provides a practical alternative. We compute the asymptotic series of the real and complex classical paths to high order, with Feynman diagrams and with a transport recursion for the cumulants, and read off the adjacency of the classical paths from the divergent tails of the series with Borel-Padé methods. The South-East rule then turns adjacency into relevance. For a particle meeting a Rosen-Morse barrier, we identify the relevant complex classical paths in front of and behind the barrier, including the complex path that carries quantum tunnelling, follow ordinary and higher-order Stokes phenomena as the final point moves, and verify the predictions with the exact propagator. The resummed series reproduce the propagator with exponential accuracy. Finally, we outline how the expansion extends to relativistic path integrals governed by a Hamiltonian constraint.
summary: 哪些复杂的经典路径有助于实时费曼路径积分？皮卡德-莱夫谢茨理论用顶针的交集数回答了这个问题，而众所周知，在无限维中计算顶针的交集数是非常困难的。我们表明，复兴提供了一种实用的替代方案。我们使用费曼图和累积量的传输递归计算实数和复杂经典路径到高阶的渐近级数，并使用 Borel-Padé 方法从级数的发散尾部读出经典路径的邻接关系。然后，东南规则将邻近性转变为相关性。对于遇到罗森-莫尔斯势垒的粒子，我们识别势垒前后的相关复杂经典路径，包括承载量子隧道效应的复杂路径，在最终点移动时遵循普通和高阶斯托克斯现象，并用精确的传播器验证预测。恢复的系列以指数精度再现传播器。最后，我们概述了展开如何扩展到受哈密顿约束控制的相对论路径积分。

title: The finite projective classification of complex spinors via momentum maps
abstract: We describe the projective orbits of complex spinors from the point of view of the momentum map. We treat the irreducible spin modules in odd dimensions 1,3,5,7,9,11 and the half-spin modules in even dimensions 2,4,6,8,10,12,14, which are the only cases with finitely many orbits. In the Clifford--Fock model, we construct representatives as sums of pure basis spinors, and the coefficients are chosen so that the representative is a critical point of the squared norm of the momentum map. The resulting momentum values in a fixed Weyl chamber distinguish the orbits. Completeness follows from Vinberg's theory of graded Lie algebras and stabilizer actions, independently of the classical spinor classifications. We recover the classical counts of 1,1,1,2,3,5 orbits in the odd cases and 1,1,1,2,2,4,9 in the even cases, and compute the projective dimension of every orbit. In dimension fourteen we also determine the closure order of the orbits, using the fact that the minimum of the squared momentum norm increases strictly under degeneration.
summary: 我们从动量图的角度描述复旋量的射影轨道。我们处理奇数维度 1,3,5,7,9,11 中的不可约自旋模和偶数维度 2,4,6,8,10,12,14 中的半自旋模，这是唯一具有有限多个轨道的情况。在 Clifford--Fock 模型中，我们将代表构造为纯基旋量之和，并选择系数以使代表成为动量图平方范数的临界点。固定外尔室中产生的动量值可区分轨道。完整性遵循 Vinberg 的分级李代数和稳定器作用理论，独立于经典旋量分类。我们恢复奇数情况下 1,1,1,2,3,5 轨道和偶数情况下 1,1,1,2,2,4,9 的经典计数，并计算每个轨道的投影维数。在第十四维中，我们还利用动量范数平方的最小值在退化下严格增加的事实来确定轨道的闭合顺序。

title: One-Particle Resonances and Eigenstate Thermalization in Periodic Free-Fermion Lattices
abstract: We study eigenstate fluctuations of the particle number in the nearest-neighbour free-fermion model on the periodic cubic lattice $(\mathbb{Z}/L\mathbb{Z})^d$. For every fixed dimension, every particle number, every subvolume, and every normalized energy eigenstate, we prove a bound of order $NL^{d-1}$ for the particle-number variance. The corresponding eigenstate-thermalization estimate is of order $L^{d-1}/(N\eta^2)$ for fluctuations of relative size $\eta$. In particular, at positive particle density the bound decays as the inverse linear size. The proof decomposes the centered particle-number operator according to one-particle energy transfer and treats the zero- and nonzero-transfer components separately. The nonzero-transfer part is controlled by a sharp resonance bound, proved from Mann's theorem on relations among roots of unity, while the zero-transfer part is estimated by a Hilbert-Schmidt argument. These bounds are optimal in every dimension: the maximal nonzero-gap multiplicity has order $L^{d-1}$, and suitable many-body eigenstates realize matching variance lower bounds and show that the concentration bound cannot be improved in estimates uniform in the tolerance parameter.
summary:
我们研究周期性立方晶格 $(\mathbb{Z}/L\mathbb{Z})^d$ 上最近邻自由费米子模型中粒子数的本征态涨落。对于每个固定维度、每个粒子数、每个子体积和每个归一化能量本征态，我们证明粒子数方差的阶数为 $NL^{d-1}$ 的界限。对于相对大小 $\eta$ 的波动，相应的本征态热化估计的量级为 $L^{d-1}/(N\eta^2)$。特别是，在正粒子密度下，束缚随着线性尺寸的倒数而衰减。该证明根据单粒子能量传递分解中心粒子数算子，并分别处理零和非零传递分量。非零传递部分由尖锐共振界控制，由曼恩单位根之间关系定理证明，而零传递部分则由希尔伯特-施密特论证估计。

这些界限在每个维度上都是最优的：最大非零间隙多重性的阶数为$L^{d-1}$，并且合适的多体本征态实现了匹配方差下界，并表明在容差参数的均匀估计中无法改进浓度界限。

title: Global Asymptotics of a Toda Soliton Condensate with Random Scattering Data
abstract: We study a dense $N$-soliton condensate for the infinite Toda lattice in the limit $N \to \infty$. In contrast to previous mathematical studies of soliton gases where the norming constants are assumed to be deterministic or infinitesimal, we consider initial scattering data where both the discrete eigenvalues and the norming constants are independent random variables. The norming constants $\gamma_j$ are allowed to be arbitrarily large under a mild moment condition $\mathbb{E}[\gamma_j^\nu] < \infty$ ($\nu > 1$). Our main result is divided into two parts. First, we develop a probabilistic Riemann--Hilbert framework to show that the system self-averages: despite large, independent fluctuations in the initial data, the random Toda lattice variables converge deterministically to an effective continuum model at a polynomial rate $\mathcal{O}(N^{-\delta})$ for $0 < \delta < 1/2$. Second, by performing the Deift--Zhou nonlinear steepest descent analysis of the continuum problem, we obtain the complete leading-order macroscopic description of the lattice across the entire space-time plane. The solution decomposes into five distinct finite-gap regimes, characterized explicitly by modulated elliptic and genus-2 waves with an error of order $\mathcal{O}(1/\ln N)$. In contrast to the straight characteristic rays typical of standard soliton gas limits, the interfaces separating these five macroscopic regimes in the space-time plane are genuinely non-linear curves; in particular, the boundary of the modulated genus-2 region is completely non-linear. Finally, under our assumptions, we establish the Nonlinear Dispersion Relations for the Toda soliton condensate and prove that the macroscopic ensemble averages are determined by the soliton gas density of states.
summary:
我们研究无限 Toda 晶格在 $N \to \infty$ 极限下的稠密 $N$-孤子凝聚。与之前的孤子气体数学研究相比，其中范数常数被假设为确定性或无穷小，我们考虑初始散射数据，其中离散特征值和范数常数都是独立的随机变量。在温和矩条件 $\mathbb{E}[\gamma_j^\nu] < \infty$ ($\nu > 1$) 下，范数常数 $\gamma_j$ 允许任意大。我们的主要结果分为两部分。首先，我们开发了一个概率黎曼-希尔伯特框架来证明系统的自平均：尽管初始数据存在较大的独立波动，但随机 Toda 晶格变量以多项式速率 $\mathcal{O}(N^{-\delta})$ 对于 $0 < \delta < 1/2$ 确定性地收敛到有效连续统模型。其次，通过对连续体问题进行Deift--Zhou非线性最速下降分析，我们获得了整个时空平面上晶格的完整前序宏观描述。

该解分解为五个不同的有限间隙区域，其特征是调制椭圆波和 genus-2 波，其误差为 $\mathcal{O}(1/\ln N)$ 阶。与标准孤子气体极限中典型的直线特征射线相反，时空平面上分隔这五个宏观区域的界面是真正的非线性曲线。特别是，调制 genus-2 区域的边界是完全非线性的。最后，在我们的假设下，我们建立了户田孤子凝聚体的非线性色散关系，并证明了宏观系综平均值是由孤子气体态密度决定的。

title: Eigenvector Occupation Statistics and Extremes in the Rosenzweig-Porter Model
abstract: We study the occupation probabilities $p_i=|u_i|^2$ of a normalized bulk eigenvector in the GUE Rosenzweig-Porter model $A_N=B_N+\tau_NG_N$, with $\tau_N^2=N^{1-\gamma}$ and $1<\gamma<2$. Conditioning on an eigenvalue at a regular bulk energy $E$ through the normalized one-eigenpair Kac-Rice law, we derive an exact finite-$N$ projective density and reduce its asymptotic analysis to a Hubbard-Stratonovich integral over $2\times2$ Hermitian matrices, which we evaluate by the saddle-point method. The resulting occupation field is governed by a self-consistent Lorentzian profile with effective resonant size $K_N(E)\asymp N^{2-\gamma}$ and local exponential fluctuations. We prove the asymptotics of all generalized inverse participation sums and identify a transition at $q=1/2$. We also obtain a two-branch thickened amplitude-counting spectrum. At the two ends of the occupation field we prove marked Poisson point-process limits: the largest components have Gumbel fluctuations, whereas the smallest component has an exponential limit on the scale $N^{-1-\gamma}$. Finally, for every fixed $q>0$ the largest component contributes an asymptotically vanishing fraction of the inverse participation sum, showing that these fixed-$q$ statistics do not freeze. The statements are quenched, uniformly on a high-probability regularity event for the diagonal disorder, and hence also hold in the annealed setting.
summary:
我们研究 GUE Rosenzweig-Porter 模型 $A_N=B_N+\tau_NG_N$ 中归一化体特征向量的占用概率 $p_i=|u_i|^2$，其中 $\tau_N^2=N^{1-\gamma}$ 和 $1<\gamma<2$。通过归一化单特征对 Kac-Rice 定律以常规体能量 $E$ 的特征值为条件，我们推导出精确的有限 $N$ 射影密度，并将其渐近分析简化为 $2\times2$ Hermitian 矩阵上的 Hubbard-Stratonovich 积分，并通过鞍点方法对其进行评估。由此产生的占据场由自洽洛伦兹分布控制，其有效共振大小为 $K_N(E)\asymp N^{2-\gamma}$ 和局部指数波动。我们证明了所有广义逆参与和的渐近性，并确定了 $q=1/2$ 处的转变。我们还获得了两分支加厚的幅度计数谱。在占据域的两端，我们证明了明显的泊松点过程极限：最大的分量具有 Gumbel 涨落，而最小的分量在 $N^{-1-\gamma}$ 尺度上具有指数极限。

最后，对于每个固定 $q>0$，最大分量贡献逆参与总和的渐近消失部分，表明这些固定 $q$ 统计数据不会冻结。这些陈述在对角线无序的高概率规律性事件上一致地被淬灭，因此在退火设置中也成立。

title: Entanglement percolation enhanced by the power of choice
abstract: Quantum communication networks are best supported by maximally entangled states, but imperfections in entanglement generation and distribution generally limit the distributed states to being only partially entangled. Therefore, protocols typically consisting of local operations and classical communication are required to create suitably entangled networks. Here, we introduce a power-of-choice (PoC) protocol based on reversing the selection criteria in the Achlioptas process previously considered in classical explosive percolation. The resulting PoC protocol anticipates the entanglement percolation transition, thereby reducing the entanglement resources needed to establish quantum communication. Notably, in contrast to explosive percolation, the PoC protocol admits an implementation using local information with no appreciable loss of performance.
summary: 量子通信网络最好由最大纠缠态支持，但纠缠生成和分布的缺陷通常将分布式态限制为仅部分纠缠。因此，需要通常由本地操作和经典通信组成的协议来创建适当的纠缠网络。在这里，我们引入了一种选择权（PoC）协议，该协议基于逆转先前在经典爆炸渗流中考虑的 Achlioptas 过程中的选择标准。由此产生的 PoC 协议预见了纠缠渗透转变，从而减少了建立量子通信所需的纠缠资源。值得注意的是，与爆炸性渗透相比，PoC 协议允许使用本地信息来实现，而不会造成明显的性能损失。

title: Can One Hear the Size of a Clock?
abstract: Weyl's law counts the vibration modes that fit into a cavity, and a quantum system with $d$ levels can oscillate at up to $d(d-1)/2$ frequencies without decay. For systems that jump at random between states, no such count was known: they oscillate only out of equilibrium, and the random timing of their jumps damps every oscillation. We find the missing count: if $Q$ is the ratio of frequency to decay rate, a system of $d$ states sustains fewer than $2(d-1)/(\pi Q)$ oscillations whose ratio exceeds $Q$. Nested cycles approach this bound, and measured oscillations reveal how large a hidden system must be.
summary: 韦尔定律计算了适合空腔的振动模式，具有 $d$ 能级的量子系统可以在高达 $d(d-1)/2$ 频率下振荡而不会衰减。对于在状态之间随机跳跃的系统，没有这样的计数：它们仅在平衡状态下振荡，并且其跳跃的随机时间会抑制每次振荡。我们找到了缺失的计数：如果$Q$是频率与衰减率的比率，则$d$状态的系统维持少于$2(d-1)/(\pi Q)$的振荡，其比率超过$Q$。嵌套循环接近这个界限，并且测量的振荡揭示了隐藏系统必须有多大。

title: Practical Ellipse Fitting for Atom Interferometry
abstract: In differential atom interferometry, it is necessary to extract the differential phase shift between two interferometers that are individually noisy. A variety of techniques can be used for this purpose, under the general label of ellipse fitting. We compare several methods for ellipse fitting, considering parameters and performance relevant to atom interferometry. Statistical, algebraic, geometric and Bayesian methods are discussed, and we describe a novel "reciprocal" geometric method that offers some benefits. Each method has advantages and disadvantages that depend on the use case required. Supplemental material includes basic Python and Matlab code for each method.
summary: 在差分原子干涉测量中，有必要提取两个各自有噪声的干涉仪之间的差分相移。在椭圆拟合的一般标签下，可以使用多种技术来实现此目的。我们比较了几种椭圆拟合方法，考虑了与原子干涉测量相关的参数和性能。讨论了统计、代数、几何和贝叶斯方法，并描述了一种新颖的“倒数”几何方法，该方法具有一些优点。每种方法都有优点和缺点，具体取决于所需的用例。补充材料包括每种方法的基本 Python 和 Matlab 代码。

title: Realizing Unstructured PDE Forecasting on Superconducting Quantum Processors
abstract: Simulating high dimensional unstructured Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) with quantum processors is a major challenge with significant potential benefit. Existing methods have been demonstrated at small qubit counts, on simplifications of realistic problems. We implement a quantum reservoir network (QRN) for forecasting high-dimensional unstructured PDEs using up to 52 qubits on IBM superconducting hardware. Our method is gradient-free and does not suffer from the challenges of variational quantum algorithms. Instead, the QRN provides a large kernel space, up to 2^52 dimensions and beyond the reach of exact classical simulation, that remains useful under current hardware noise levels. Furthermore, a partial measure-and-reset mechanism enables total circuit runtime for ~24 times the qubit coherence time, so qubit lifetimes do not limit the forecast horizon. Thus, our method enables forecasting realistic unstructured nonlinear PDEs on quantum hardware. Typical difficulties associated with predicting large scale PDEs, such as transpilation, exponential shot requirements, hardware noise, and short qubit lifetimes are mitigated through careful design considerations and a dynamic observable reconstruction method. We validate our approach using a ~34k cell unstructured 2D cylinder flow at Reynolds number 1000 and a challenging nonlinear Gray--Scott reaction--diffusion problem, demonstrating high fidelity prediction on CUDA-Q simulation and on 26 and 52-qubit superconducting quantum processors. Specifically, we show that adding QRN features to an autoencoder linear prediction pipeline reduces prediction error by 21%-43%. Finally, we demonstrate closed-loop autoregressive PDE forecasting on these problems. This work demonstrates, for the first time, quantum circuits with depth beyond qubit lifetimes achieving accurate unstructured mesh forecasting on highly nonlinear PDEs.
summary:
使用量子处理器模拟高维非结构化偏微分方程 (PDE) 是一项重大挑战，但具有巨大的潜在优势。现有的方法已经在小量子比特数和现实问题的简化上得到了证明。我们在 IBM 超导硬件上使用多达 52 个量子位实现了一个量子储层网络 (QRN)，用于预测高维非结构化偏微分方程。我们的方法是无梯度的，并且不会受到变分量子算法的挑战。相反，QRN 提供了一个大的内核空间，高达 2^52 维度，超出了精确经典模拟的范围，这在当前硬件噪声水平下仍然有用。此外，部分测量和重置机制使总电路运行时间约为量子位相干时间的 24 倍，因此量子位寿命不会限制预测范围。因此，我们的方法能够在量子硬件上预测现实的非结构化非线性偏微分方程。

通过仔细的设计考虑和动态可观测重建方法，可以缓解与预测大规模偏微分方程相关的典型困难，例如转译、指数发射要求、硬件噪声和短量子位寿命。我们使用雷诺数为 1000 的约 34k 单元非结构化 2D 圆柱流和具有挑战性的非线性格雷 - 斯科特反应 - 扩散问题来验证我们的方法，证明了 CUDA-Q 模拟以及 26 和 52 量子位超导量子处理器上的高保真度预测。具体来说，我们表明，将 QRN 特征添加到自动编码器线性预测管道中可以将预测误差降低 21%-43%。最后，我们演示了对这些问题的闭环自回归 PDE 预测。这项工作首次证明了深度超过量子位寿命的量子电路可以在高度非线性偏微分方程上实现精确的非结构化网格预测。

title: A trace costs one quantifier: the exact complexity of perfect play in nonlocal games
abstract: Given a finite nonlocal game, can the players win with certainty? We prove that the existence of a perfect normal spatial strategy is $\Sigma^0_2$-complete, even when restricted to games of value one, so it cannot be decided even with an oracle for the halting problem. This is strictly harder than perfect play in the finite-dimensional and commuting-operator models, which are $\Sigma^0_1$-complete and $\Pi^0_1$-complete. Within the commuting model, the existence of a perfect normal strategy with a finite or semifinite von Neumann host is $\Sigma^0_2$-complete, whereas for every fixed type $\mathrm{III}_\lambda$ subtype it has the same $\Pi^0_1$-complete language as unrestricted commuting play. A trace thus costs one existential number quantifier: the hardness constructions force every perfect strategy to choose a finite clock period or a finite tree depth. Spatial $\Sigma^0_2$-completeness also holds when finite entanglement entropy is required, and both forms are formally verified in Lean. For every computable $0<\alpha<1$, perfect spatial play with $\mathrm{Tr}\,h^\alpha<\infty$ for the reduced density $h$ is $\Sigma^0_2$-complete as well; these conditions form a strict ladder between finite rank and finite entropy. We also prove $\Sigma^0_2$-completeness for one-shot zero-error communication with normal entanglement, and construct a finite channel with zero-error codes of a given size each of which needs infinite entanglement entropy.
summary:
给定一个有限的非局部博弈，玩家能确定获胜吗？我们证明了完美的正态空间策略的存在是$\Sigma^0_2$-完整的，即使仅限于价值一的游戏，因此即使使用针对停机问题的预言机也无法确定它。这比有限维和通勤算子模型中的完美游戏要严格得多，这些模型是$\Sigma^0_1$-完全的和$\Pi^0_1$-完全的。在通勤模型中，具有有限或半有限冯·诺依曼主机的完美正态策略的存在是$\Sigma^0_2$-完整的，而对于每个固定类型$\mathrm{III}_\lambda$子类型，它具有与无限制通勤游戏相同的$\Pi^0_1$-完整语言。因此，一条踪迹需要一个存在数量词：硬度结构迫使每一个完美的策略选择有限的时钟周期或有限的树深度。当需要有限纠缠熵时，空间 $\Sigma^0_2$ 完整性也成立，并且这两种形式都在 Lean 中得到了正式验证。

对于每个可计算的 $0<\alpha<1$，$\mathrm{Tr}\,h^\alpha<\infty$ 对于降低的密度 $h$ 的完美空间游戏也是 $\Sigma^0_2$ 完成的；这些条件在有限秩和有限熵之间形成了严格的阶梯。我们还证明了具有正常纠缠的一次性零错误通信的$\Sigma^0_2$-完整性，并构造了一个具有给定大小的零错误代码的有限通道，每个零错误代码都需要无限的纠缠熵。

title: QAOA Inside ADMM: Subproblem Wins Do Not Become Decomposition Wins at Matched Budgets
abstract: We benchmark the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) as the binary subproblem solver in a two-block alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) for mixed-binary problems against classical solvers under matched budgets. With 23 optimizer evaluations per subproblem, scoring determines the comparison: on its final readout, the optimized QAOA loses to random search at $n=12$ and 16 binary variables (inconclusive at 20; exploratory and post hoc tests). When credited with its best sample, it wins. In a noiseless 12-qubit simulation, transferred-angle depth-2 QAOA finds the exact optimum of 97.3\% of planted-family subproblems, against 50.6\%--67.4\% for the four strongest local heuristics (100\% against 90.4\%--94.4\% crediting the four best bitstrings) and a not significantly different 96.5\% for semidefinite rounding with local search (SDP+LS). Under our evaluation-counting convention, its time to solution there is a factor of three to five below the local heuristics' but grows with a larger exponent; it is ten times that of SDP+LS and, in seconds, 54 times that of tabu search with restarts. For the benchmark class, an unconstrained binary quadratic problem in disguise, ADMM's binary step is a proximal step on the reduced problem: at unit penalty ADMM re-solves it, and for larger penalties exact solutions increasingly stall. On two families that do not reduce to one, less accurate solvers found the problem optimum more often at unit and larger penalties. No family gave QAOA a better ADMM outcome than the best classical solver and penalty. The benchmark includes a correctness gate and a log of its hypothesis tests.
summary:
我们将量子近似优化算法（QAOA）作为双块交替方向乘法器（ADMM）中的二元子问题求解器进行基准测试，以针对匹配预算下的经典求解器来解决混合二元问题。每个子问题有 23 个优化器评估，评分决定了比较：在最终读数中，优化的 QAOA 输给了 $n=12$ 和 16 个二元变量的随机搜索（20 个不确定；探索性和事后测试）。当它被认为是最好的样本时，它就获胜了。在无噪声 12 量子位模拟中，转移角深度 2 QAOA 找到了 97.3\% 的种植族子问题的精确最优值，而对于四个最强的局部启发式，则为 50.6\%--67.4\%（100\% 对 90.4\%--94.4\%，归功于四个最佳位串），对于半定子问题，则为 96.5\%，没有显着差异使用本地搜索（SDP+LS）进行舍入。根据我们的评估计数惯例，解决问题的时间比本地启发式低三到五倍，但会以更大的指数增长；它是SDP+LS的10倍，以秒为单位，是带有重启的禁忌搜索的54倍。

对于基准类（变相的无约束二元二次问题），ADMM 的二元步骤是简化问题的最接近步骤：在单位惩罚下，ADMM 重新求解它，而对于较大的惩罚，精确解决方案会逐渐停滞。在两个不简化为一的族中，不太准确的求解器更常在单位和更大的惩罚下发现问题最优。没有哪个家族给予 QAOA 比最好的经典求解器和惩罚更好的 ADMM 结果。该基准包括正确性门和假设检验的日志。

title: Compact Quantum Channel Attention for Static ASL Recognition: A Controlled Study with Parameter-Matched Baselines
abstract: Hybrid quantum-classical models often report good accuracy on image tasks, but it is rarely clear whether the quantum part is responsible. This paper proposes QCA-DenseNet, a static American Sign Language (ASL) recognition pipeline in which an eight-qubit variational circuit acts as a channel-attention gate on DenseNet121 features. The quantum channel attention (QCA) gate has 17,464 parameters, 7.51 times fewer than a squeeze-and-excitation (SE) block. The pipeline is tested on 1,815 MU HandImages images by holding out one of five signers at a time, and a frozen-backbone ablation uses small parts of the Kaggle ASL Alphabet data. On unseen signers, QCA-DenseNet reaches 94.50% mean accuracy, above SE (93.72%) and within 0.28 points of the best model. A matched classical MLP and a model without attention perform about the same, and no difference is significant. QCA gives a much smaller attention gate without a detectable loss in accuracy, but no quantum advantage.
summary: 混合量子经典模型通常在图像任务上表现出良好的准确性，但很少清楚量子部分是否负责。本文提出了 QCA-DenseNet，这是一种静态美国手语 (ASL) 识别管道，其中八量子位变分电路充当 DenseNet121 特征上的通道注意门。量子通道注意力 (QCA) 门有 17,464 个参数，比挤压激励 (SE) 模块少 7.51 倍。该管道在 1,815 MU HandImages 图像上进行了测试，每次显示五个签名者之一，并且冻结骨干消融使用 Kaggle ASL Alphabet 数据的一小部分。对于看不见的签名者，QCA-DenseNet 的平均准确率达到 94.50%，高于 SE (93.72%)，与最佳模型的差距在 0.28 个百分点以内。匹配的经典 MLP 和没有注意力的模型表现大致相同，并且没有显着差异。 QCA 提供了一个小得多的注意力门，没有可检测到的准确性损失，但没有量子优势。

title: Initialization masks overcome decoding obstructions in compressed QAOA
abstract: In compressed quantum optimization, a variational state is converted into a classical assignment by decoding noncommuting observables. We show that this step creates structural restrictions that changing the initialization can remove, even when increasing circuit depth cannot. For an explicit infinite family of connected cubic graphs on $n=3r$ vertices, with a fixed Pauli encoding and deterministic sign decoder, every all-plus QAOA circuit has cut at most $2r$, at every finite depth and every real angle sequence. A uniform signed product-state mask at fixed depth-one angles has expected cut $13r/4$, an additive advantage $5n/12$; an infinite subfamily admits an optimal mask. A second construction retains a linear depth-one separation under weak weighted couplings, a bounded cost-angle domain and a specified production-encoder ordering. Noiseless simulations then test classical mask selection before energy optimization. On 1,699 random cubic MaxCut instances, one selected mask achieves mean ratio $0.9100$, versus $0.7067$ for the all-plus $X$ baseline and $0.9125$ for the best of $r^2$ separately optimized random masks. On complete cohorts of weighted MaxCut, sparse Ising, Max-2-XOR and Max-2-SAT, the selected mask also improves on the baseline at every size, but it trails the pool at small sizes and leads it significantly only at the larger MaxCut and Ising sizes. Finite-pool order statistics separate the effect of selection from that of drawing a random mask. The results distinguish decoded expressivity from optimized energy and empirical performance; they do not establish a quantum computational advantage.
summary:
在压缩量子优化中，通过解码不可交换可观测量将变分状态转换为经典分配。我们表明，这一步产生了结构限制，改变初始化可以消除这些限制，即使增加电路深度也不能消除。对于 $n=3r$ 顶点上的显式无限族连通立方图，使用固定的泡利编码和确定性符号解码器，每个全加 QAOA 电路在每个有限深度和每个实角序列上最多切割 $2r$。固定深度一角度的统一签名产品状态掩模预计削减 $13r/4$，附加优势 $5n/12$；无限亚族允许最优掩模。第二种结构在弱加权耦合、有界成本角度域和指定的生产编码器排序下保留线性深度一分离。然后，在能量优化之前，进行无噪声模拟测试经典掩模选择。在 1,699 个随机立方 MaxCut 实例中，一个选定的掩模达到平均比率 $0.9100$，而所有加 $X$ 基线的平均比率为 $0.7067$，对于最佳的 $r^2$ 单独优化的随机掩模为 $0.9125$。

在加权 MaxCut、稀疏 Ising、Max-2-XOR 和 Max-2-SAT 的完整队列中，所选掩模在每个尺寸的基线上也有所改进，但它在小尺寸时落后于池，并且仅在较大的 MaxCut 和 Ising 尺寸时显着领先。有限池顺序统计将选择的效果与绘制随机掩模的效果分开。结果将解码的表现力与优化的能量和经验性能区分开来；他们没有建立量子计算优势。

title: Simulating the quantum switch with quantum circuits is impossible
abstract: The quantum switch is a higher-order transformation that combines input quantum channels in an indefinite causal order. Whether quantum circuits can simulate its action, and how many calls to the input channels such a simulation requires, are natural questions about the power of quantum control of causal order. In this work, we prove that no quantum circuit with classically controlled causal order can exactly and deterministically simulate the quantum switch for arbitrary input channels using any finite number of calls. This impossibility holds already for qubit channels and extends to the complete $r$-switch, which coherently controls all permutations of $r$ input channels. These results settle the question of exact deterministic circuit simulation of the quantum switch. They demonstrate that processes with indefinite causal order cannot, in general, be efficiently simulated in this setting even by quantum circuits with classically controlled causal order.
summary: 量子开关是一种高阶变换，它以不确定的因果顺序组合输入量子通道。量子电路是否可以模拟其行为，以及这种模拟需要多少次调用输入通道，是关于因果顺序的量子控制能力的自然问题。在这项工作中，我们证明没有任何具有经典控制因果顺序的量子电路可以使用任何有限数量的调用来精确且确定地模拟任意输入通道的量子开关。这种不可能性已经适用于量子位通道，并扩展到完整的 $r$ 开关，它连贯地控制 $r$ 输入通道的所有排列。这些结果解决了量子开关的精确确定性电路模拟的问题。他们证明，即使通过具有经典控制因果顺序的量子电路，通常也无法在这种情况下有效地模拟具有不确定因果顺序的过程。

title: A Grover-Amplified Oracle for Maximum Clique on Graph, Minimum Hitting set and Dualizations on Hypergraphs Built on Quantum Phase Estimation
abstract: In this paper, we use a quantum circuit called the Graph Encoding Operator which, applied to the complement $\bar G$ of any graph $G$, yields an oracle for the maximum clique problem suitable for amplification via Grover's algorithm. Analogously, we devise a Hypergraph Encoding Operator which, when applied to a hypergraph $\mathcal H$, yields an oracle for the minimum hitting set suitable for amplification via Grover's algorithm. Interestingly, the latter oracle provides, when measured, an approximation of the number of hitting sets of the hypergraph, thus solving the dualization problem for positive Boolean functions represented in a positive irredundant disjunctive normal form. We give the full construction of both operators, prove their correctness, analyze their complexity, and provide an implementation on a quantum simulator. We discuss the resulting complexity, contrast them with existing quantum computer algorithms based on Grover search and we will show that our algorithms outperform, to the best of our knowledge, all of the previous algorithms on space computational complexity by requiring only $O(N)$ number of qubits with respect to the number of vertices $N$, for representing both graphs and hypergraphs in the encoding operator and, consequently, results in an oracle for both graphs and hypergraphs that uses only $O(N)$ qubits even when the hypergraph contains an exponential (on the number of vertices) number of hyperedges.
summary:
在本文中，我们使用称为图编码算子的量子电路，将其应用于任何图 $G$ 的补 $\bar G$，产生适合通过 Grover 算法放大的最大团问题的预言。类似地，我们设计了一个超图编码运算符，当应用于超图 $\mathcal H$ 时，会生成适合通过 Grover 算法放大的最小命中集的预言。有趣的是，后一个预言在测量时提供了超图命中集数量的近似值，从而解决了以正不冗余析取范式表示的正布尔函数的对偶问题。我们给出了两个算子的完整构造，证明了它们的正确性，分析了它们的复杂性，并提供了在量子模拟器上的实现。

我们讨论由此产生的复杂性，将它们与基于 Grover 搜索的现有量子计算机算法进行对比，并且我们将证明，据我们所知，我们的算法在空间计算复杂性方面优于所有先前的算法，因为仅需要 $O(N)$ 相对于顶点数量 $N$ 的量子比特数来表示编码运算符中的图和超图，因此，结果是仅使用 $O(N)$ 的图和超图的预言机。即使超图包含指数（顶点数量）数量的超边，量子位也是如此。

title: Dispersion interaction between two bodies of arbitrary shape
abstract: Based on the vacuum tensor Green's functions of electrodynamics, the Lippmann-Schwinger-type equations were derived for the correlations of electromagnetic fields. These correlations were applied within the Maxwell stress tensor and the Lorentz force formula to determine Casimir dispersion forces for two arbitrary bodies. The analysis is performed by the excitation of bodies by electric and magnetic dipoles.
summary: 基于电动力学真空张量格林函数，推导了电磁场相关性的Lippmann-Schwinger型方程。这些相关性应用于麦克斯韦应力张量和洛伦兹力公式，以确定两个任意物体的卡西米尔色散力。该分析是通过电偶极子和磁偶极子激励物体来进行的。

title: Trained, Frozen, or Absent: Identifying What a Quantum Layer Contributes to Cross-Sectional Equity Ranking
abstract: Hybrid quantumclassical models are increasingly proposed for nancial prediction, but reported gains are rarely separated from the classical components around them. We study a hybrid quantum temporal convolutional network for daily cross-sectional ranking of 2000 Tokyo Stock Exchange equities under a protocol built to make the quantum contribution identiable: six conditions (circuit trained, frozen or absent, a parameter-matched classical surrogate, and the circuit alone, trained or frozen) through one code path; four walk-forward folds with ve seeds; bootstrap intervals, Deated Sharpe Ratios, backtest-overtting probabilities and family-wise error control; ve classical baselines including a gradient-boosted tree; and a locked holdout. On 500 out-of-sample days two one-sided tests place the trained-versus-frozen dierence inside 0.03 annualised Sharpe (p = 0.0055, minimum detectable eect 0.02): the circuit is equivalent to a frozen one, not merely indistinguishable from it. With the circuit as the head's only input the two are equivalent inside 0.25; against the network with no circuit the design resolves only 0.50. No condition is distinguishable from zero (best De-ated Sharpe Ratio 0.17).
