The holdout reproduces the ablation on a protable window, and 2000 US equities reproduce it where every condition loses money.
summary:
混合量子经典模型越来越多地被提出用于金融预测，但报告的收益很少与其周围的经典组件分开。我们研究了一种混合量子时间卷积网络，用于根据一种协议对 2000 只东京证券交易所股票进行每日横截面排名，该协议旨在使量子贡献可识别：通过一个代码路径的六种条件（经过训练的电路、冻结或不存在、参数匹配的经典代理以及单独的电路、经过训练或冻结）；四个向前折叠，带有 5 个种子；自举区间、Deated Sharpe 比率、回测过度概率和族级误差控制；五个经典基线，包括梯度增强树；和一个锁定的坚持者。在 500 个样本外的日子里，两次单方面测试将训练与冻结的差异置于 0.03 年化夏普范围内（p = 0.0055，最小可检测效应 0.02）：该电路相当于冻结电路，而不仅仅是无法区分。当电路作为头部的唯一输入时，两者的等效值在 0.25 以内；与没有电路的网络相比，该设计的分辨率仅为 0.50。

没有任何条件可以与零区分开（最佳减值夏普比率 0.17）。抵制者在有利可图的窗口上重现了这种消融，而 2000 种美国股票则在每种条件都亏损的情况下重现了这种情况。

title: MEAT with source and detector correlations
abstract: We prove variants of the marginal-constrained entropy accumulation theorem (MEAT) that enable finite-size security analysis of quantum key distribution with source and detector correlations. For source correlations, our results allow for the state prepared in a given round to depend on the current setting choice and a finite number of preceding choices. For detector correlations, our results require memory effects to persist for a finite number of rounds after a registered click, and all detectors to be switched off during those rounds. These results can be combined, providing, to the best of our knowledge, the first method to jointly treat correlated source and detector imperfections in quantum key distribution. Moreover, we retain all the benefits of the MEAT, such as (but not limited to) support for on-the-fly announcements and choice of adaptive tradeoff functions. The resulting key rates can be computed via a single-round optimization amenable to existing numerical methods. We demonstrate these results on qubit BB84, and exhibit competitive key rates even in the presence of correlated source and detector imperfections.
summary: 我们证明了边际约束熵累积定理（MEAT）的变体，该定理能够对具有源和检测器相关性的量子密钥分布进行有限大小的安全分析。对于源相关性，我们的结果允许在给定回合中准备的状态取决于当前设置选择和有限数量的先前选择。对于检测器相关性，我们的结果要求记忆效应在注册点击后持续有限轮数，并且在这些轮次期间关闭所有检测器。据我们所知，这些结果可以结合起来，提供第一种联合处理量子密钥分配中相关源和探测器缺陷的方法。此外，我们保留了 MEAT 的所有优点，例如（但不限于）对动态公告的支持和自适应权衡函数的选择。所得到的关键速率可以通过适合现有数值方法的单轮优化来计算。我们在量子位 BB84 上展示了这些结果，即使存在相关源和探测器缺陷，也表现出有竞争力的关键速率。

title: Periodic Readout Induces a First-Order Generalization Transition in a Quantum Perceptron
abstract: Variational quantum classifiers can generate highly structured decision boundaries through the Fourier dependence of observable expectation values on circuit parameters. We show that expressivity can come at a sharp statistical cost, by considering a quantum perceptron whose readout is the simplest periodic classifier, namely a square-wave function of the weighted inputs, and determine its typical generalization in the thermodynamic limit using a teacher-student replica-symmetric theory. Above a critical oscillation frequency, increasing the training load induces a first-order transition from weakly to strongly teacher-aligned phases, resulting in a discontinuous improvement in generalization. At fixed load, however, increasing the frequency eventually drives the equilibrium generalization error to chance level, despite perfect classification of all the training examples. Thus, the same periodic structure that enhances random-label storage can delay the onset of learning. Our results expose a quantitative tradeoff between memorization and generalization generated purely by periodic readout, and provide a benchmark for understanding Fourier-rich variational quantum classifiers.
summary: 变分量子分类器可以通过可观察期望值对电路参数的傅里叶依赖性来生成高度结构化的决策边界。我们通过考虑量子感知器的读数是最简单的周期分类器，即加权输入的方波函数，并使用师生复制对称理论确定其在热力学极限中的典型推广，证明表现力可能会付出高昂的统计成本。在临界振荡频率之上，增加训练负载会导致从弱教师对齐阶段到强教师对齐阶段的一阶转变，从而导致泛化能力的不连续改进。然而，在固定负载下，尽管所有训练示例都进行了完美分类，但增加频率最终会将均衡泛化误差推向机会水平。因此，增强随机标签存储的相同周期性结构可以延迟学习的开始。我们的结果揭示了纯粹由周期性读出产生的记忆和泛化之间的定量权衡，并为理解富傅里叶变分量子分类器提供了基准。

title: Bridging Gaps with Tensor Networks: From the Haldane Gap and Beyond
abstract: Proofs generated by large language models are often difficult to understand, generalize, or formalize directly. Here we verify, digest, and formalize OpenAI's computer-assisted proof of a uniform gap in the periodic spin-1 Heisenberg chain using tensor-network diagrams and Lean 4. Reading the partition-function network along space and imaginary time shows how finite-ring bounds propagate across doubled lengths and inverse temperatures to all longer even rings, sharpening the spin-1 bound from the same finite inputs by a factor of 19 to $\Delta_L > 0.0729$ for all even $L \geq 36$. We identify reflection positivity as the general condition behind the proof and certify uniform gaps in seven additional spin chains and ladders. More broadly, digesting machine-generated proofs into transparent physical mechanisms yields sharper bounds, broader theorems, and reusable formal verifications.
summary: 由大型语言模型生成的证明通常难以直接理解、概括或形式化。在这里，我们使用张量网络图和 Lean 4 来验证、消化和形式化 OpenAI 对周期性自旋 1 海森堡链中均匀间隙的计算机辅助证明。沿着空间和虚时间读取配分函数网络显示有限环边界如何跨双倍长度和逆温度传播到所有更长的偶数环，将相同有限输入的自旋 1 边界锐化 19 倍，对于所有偶数 $\Delta_L > 0.0729$ $L \geq 36$。我们将反射正性确定为证明背后的一般条件，并证明七个附加自旋链和梯子中的均匀间隙。更广泛地说，将机器生成的证明消化成透明的物理机制会产生更清晰的界限、更广泛的定理和可重复使用的形式验证。

title: Towards large-scale ab initio Molecular Dynamics Simulation with Efficient Sampling-based Quantum Computing Algorithms
abstract: Ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) requires the calculation of highly accurate electronic-structure energies and nuclear forces at every time step, which can quickly become computationally expensive. Sample-based quantum diagonalization offers a route to such calculations on quantum hardware, but its use in AIMD simulations has so far been limited to active spaces of about 20 qubits. In these spaces, exact diagonalization is tractable, and the quantum circuits are typically built from standard coupled-cluster amplitudes. Here, we introduce SqDRIFT-AIMD, which combines randomized sample-based Krylov quantum diagonalization (SqDRIFT) with analytical nuclear gradients. With SqDRIFT-AIMD, we obtain more accurate ground-state energies than the conventional coupled-cluster singles and doubles (CCSD) driven AIMD simulation for the $40$-qubit active space. We apply SqDRIFT-AIMD to study the dynamics of proton transfer in the Zundel cation, using circuits executed on IBM Heron r3 quantum processors. SqDRIFT energies fall below CCSD across the $40$-qubit double-well PES and stay within a few m$E_\text{h}$ of CCSD at 52 qubits. The $40$-qubit SqDRIFT-AIMD trajectory tracks the SHCI-driven proton transfer to within $1.33$ mÅ and exhibits excellent total energy conservation, with a standard deviation of only $0.245$ m$E_\text{h}$. These results extend quantum-centric AIMD to active spaces beyond the reach of exact diagonalization.
summary:
从头算分子动力学 (AIMD) 需要在每个时间步骤计算高精度的电子结构能量和核力，这很快就会变得计算成本高昂。基于样本的量子对角化为在量子硬件上进行此类计算提供了一条途径，但其在 AIMD 模拟中的使用迄今为止仅限于约 20 个量子位的活动空间。在这些空间中，精确的对角化是容易处理的，并且量子电路通常是根据标准耦合簇振幅构建的。在这里，我们介绍 SqDRIFT-AIMD，它将基于随机样本的 Krylov 量子对角化 (SqDRIFT) 与分析核梯度相结合。通过 SqDRIFT-AIMD，我们在 40 美元的量子位活动空间中获得了比传统的耦合团簇单团簇和双团团 (CCSD) 驱动的 AIMD 模拟更准确的基态能量。我们使用在 IBM Heron r3 量子处理器上执行的电路，应用 SqDRIFT-AIMD 研究 Zundel 阳离子中质子转移的动力学。 SqDRIFT 能量在 40 美元量子位双井 PES 上低于 CCSD，并在 52 量子位时保持在 CCSD 的几个 m$E_\text{h}$ 范围内。

40 美元量子位 SqDRIFT-AIMD 轨迹将 SHCI 驱动的质子转移跟踪到 1.33 美元 mÅ 以内，并表现出出色的总能量守恒，标准偏差仅为 0.245 美元 m$E_\text{h}$。这些结果将以量子为中心的 AIMD 扩展到超出精确对角化范围的活动空间。

title: Adaptive Quantum Metrology of Gravitational Waves
abstract: We develop a feedback-controlled quantum metrology scheme to probe weak gravitational waves (GWs) through their direct energy exchange with light. Adaptive SU(2) direction control, based on current estimates of the GW frequency and phase, allows the frequency shifts acquired in successive interaction intervals to add rather than cancel. The resulting persistent frequency difference is converted into an optical phase difference for interferometric readout. We further extend the scheme to elliptically polarized GWs using two transverse sensing channels separated by $45^\circ$ to probe the $+$ and $\times$ components independently. After the GW interaction, the two signals are mapped onto orthogonal polarization modes, enabling phase accumulation along a common path. We derive the corresponding quantum Fisher information matrix and find a $T_{\rm int}^2T_{\rm ph}^2$ scaling in the ideal coherent regime. For a fixed-photon-number probe, the sensitivity shows Heisenberg-like $1/n$ scaling in the ideal case.
summary: 我们开发了一种反馈控制的量子计量方案，通过弱引力波（GW）与光的直接能量交换来探测它们。自适应 SU(2) 方向控制基于 GW 频率和相位的当前估计，允许添加而不是取消在连续交互间隔中获取的频移。由此产生的持续频率差被转换为用于干涉读数的光学相位差。我们进一步将该方案扩展到椭圆偏振引力波，使用两个相隔 $45^\circ$ 的横向传感通道来独立探测 $+$ 和 $\times$ 分量。 GW 交互后，两个信号被映射到正交偏振模式，从而实现沿公共路径的相位累积。我们推导出相应的量子费希尔信息矩阵，并找到理想相干状态下的 $T_{\rm int}^2T_{\rm ph}^2$ 缩放。对于固定光子数探测器，理想情况下灵敏度显示出类似海森堡的 $1/n$ 缩放比例。

title: Hardware-Efficient Continuous-Variable Quantum Computation: Finite-$N$ Non-Gaussian Gates in a Floquet-Engineered Cavity-BEC
abstract: Continuous-variable (CV) quantum computation in bosonic modes offers a hardware-efficient route toward fault tolerance, yet synthesizing deterministic, macroscopic non-Gaussian gates with Wigner negativity remains challenging. Here, we establish two physical breakthroughs and two tensor-network innovations using a single-cavity 87Rb Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) as a macroscopic bosonic logical mode. Physically, building on our orthogonal optical dual-driving architecture, we propose deterministic, unitary Floquet-engineered Two-Axis Twisting (TAT) non-Gaussian gates without post-selection, and introduce a paradigm shift from quantum metrology to CV quantum computation: via a normal-ordered Holstein-Primakoff expansion and non-perturbative spin simulations, we show that the over-squeezed regime ($t>t_{opt}$, where Wineland squeezing $\xi_R^2$ degrades) harnesses finite-$N$ Bloch-sphere curvature - manifesting at $O(1/S)$ as cubic shearing and quartic Kerr $(a^\dagger a)^2$ interactions - to deterministically generate Wigner negativity. Methodologically, we formulate an exact automaton Matrix Product Operator in the compact SU(2) spin basis with an $N$-independent Liouvillian bond dimension ($D_L=6$), bypassing Fock cutoff errors ($N_{max}$) and $O(N^3)$ permutational-invariant scaling. Finally, we decouple $4^N$-dimensional Lindblad evolution from collective observation via an Exact Bilateral Dynamic Programming Dicke Projector with log-gamma normalization, extracting the $(N+1)\times(N+1)$ symmetric projection $\tilde{\rho}_{n_L,n_R}$ without moment truncation while tracking symmetry retention $p_{sym}(t)$. Our proof-of-principle $N=50$ benchmark resolves deep Wigner negativity ($W_{min} \approx -0.214$ at $t=2.00\mu$s, after $\xi_R^2 \approx 0.124$ at $t_{opt} \approx 0.64\mu$s), establishing a scalable architecture for $N \sim 10^3-10^5$ macroscopic BEC processors.
summary:
玻色子模式下的连续变量 (CV) 量子计算为实现容错提供了一种硬件高效的途径，但合成具有维格纳负性的确定性宏观非高斯门仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们使用单腔 87Rb 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体 (BEC) 作为宏观玻色子逻辑模式，实现了两项物理突破和两项张量网络创新。在物理上，基于我们的正交光学双驱动架构，我们提出了确定性的、酉 Floquet 设计的无后选择的两轴扭转 (TAT) 非高斯门，并引入了从量子计量到 CV 量子计算的范式转变：通过正序 Holstein-Primakoff 展开和非扰动自旋模拟，我们表明过度压缩状态（$t>t_{opt}$，其中 Wineland 挤压 $\xi_R^2$ 会降级）利用有限的 $N$ 布洛赫球曲率 - 在 $O(1/S)$ 处表现为三次剪切和四次 Kerr $(a^\dagger a)^2$ 相互作用 - 确定性地生成维格纳负性。

在方法上，我们在紧凑的 SU(2) 自旋基础上制定了一个精确的自动机矩阵乘积运算符，具有 $N$ 独立的刘维尔键维数 ($D_L=6$)，绕过了 Fock 截止误差 ($N_{max}$) 和 $O(N^3)$ 排列不变缩放。最后，我们通过具有对数伽玛归一化的精确双边动态规划迪克投影仪将 $4^N$ 维 Lindblad 演化与集体观察解耦，提取 $(N+1)\times(N+1)$ 对称投影 $\tilde{\rho}_{n_L,n_R}$ 而无需矩截断，同时跟踪对称保留 $p_{sym}(t)$。我们的原理验证 $N=50$ 基准解决了深层维格纳负性（$W_{min} \approx -0.214$ at $t=2.00\mu$s，$\xi_R^2 \approx 0.124$ at $t_{opt} \approx 0.64\mu$s），为 $N \sim 10^3-10^5$ 建立了一个可扩展的架构宏观 BEC 处理器。

title: What an Observer Reads off a Holographic Screen
abstract: What does an observer read off a holographic screen that is an array of qubits rather than a surface? In the generalized holographic principle the interaction between two separable systems acts on such a screen as a weighted sum, up to an overall prefactor, of commuting observables with values plus and minus one. When the weights are nonnegative and the prefactor is one and the joint eigenspaces are lines, everything a probe reads off the spectrum depends only on the list of weights, which we call the profile. On the screen with equal weights summing to one the running dimension read by a diffusion probe falls short of two at unit time by at most twice the reciprocal of the number of qubits; a geometric profile gives instead, through its level count, a plateau of any positive height. An observer correlates sets of qubits; its readout carries a profile at a given weighting when the levels it reads, counted with multiplicity, are those of a screen with one weight per set. We prove that a readout carries a profile at every weighting exactly when the distinct nonzero traces of its qubits are linearly independent over the field with two elements, the trace of a qubit being the list of sets that contain it; such a readout is a partition of the qubits it covers up to an invertible recoding, and a dependent one carries a profile only on finitely many proper linear subspaces of weightings. Refining a grouping without end builds a tower whose boundary is a profinite set and hence a condensed set, on which a strictly positive compatible profile separates the locally constant functions by a distance. Applications certify probabilistic and strong contextuality and give the leading shortfall of the distance between the poles of the fuzzy sphere; in a model of monogamous entanglement the pairs that weight-one threads representing operational ER=EPR can occupy at once are exactly the partial matchings.
summary:
观察者从由量子位阵列而不是表面组成的全息屏幕上读出什么？在广义全息原理中，两个可分离系统之间的相互作用在这样的屏幕上充当加权和，直至具有正负一值的通勤可观测量的总体先因子。当权重为非负且前因子为 1 并且联合特征空间为线时，探测器从频谱中读取的所有内容仅取决于权重列表，我们将其称为轮廓。在权重相等的屏幕上，扩散探针读取的运行尺寸在单位时间内最多小于 2，最多是量子位数量倒数的两倍；相反，几何轮廓通过其水平计数给出任何正高度的平台。观察者将量子位组关联起来；当它读取的水平（按多重性计算）是每组一个权重的屏幕的水平时，其读数带有给定权重的轮廓。

我们证明，当其量子位的不同非零迹线在具有两个元素的场上线性无关时，读出在每个权重处都具有轮廓，量子位的迹线是包含它的集合的列表；这种读出是它所覆盖的量子位的一个分区，直至可逆重新编码，并且依赖的读出仅在有限多个正确的权重线性子空间上携带轮廓。细化一个没有终点的分组会构建一座塔，其边界是有限集，因此是一个凝聚集，在该塔上，严格正兼容的轮廓将局部常数函数分开一段距离。应用证明了概率性和强上下文性，并给出了模糊球极点之间距离的主要不足；在一夫一妻制纠缠模型中，表示操作 ER=EPR 的权重一线程可以同时占据的对正是部分匹配。

title: Alchemically Transferable Parameters for Variational Quantum Eigensolvers
abstract: Machine-learned circuit parameters could remove one of the main bottlenecks of variational quantum eigensolvers: the classical optimization loop, with its typical barren plateaus, local minima, and costly energy and gradient evaluations, is replaced by a direct prediction. Prior work showed that machine-learning models paired with a structured circuit design can transfer across system size and structure within hydrogenic systems. The next step: Extending them to organic molecules would seem to require re-training on use-case-specific training sets. In this work, we show that this is not necessary by establishing an alchemical approach. A geometric projection places surrogate hydrogen atoms along the bond directions of the target molecule and so maps its local bonding environment onto small hydrogenic fragments. Existing hydrogenic solvers can then be reused as they are. The only new quantity is a single projection radius per bond type, which is fitted once on a small reference molecule and reused unchanged thereafter. We demonstrate the approach on the separable-pair circuit designs that have been used in prior work and extend the approach to multi-circuit approaches that span effective bases for quantum subspaces.
summary:
机器学习的电路参数可以消除变分量子本征求解器的主要瓶颈之一：经典优化循环具有典型的贫瘠高原、局部极小值以及昂贵的能量和梯度评估，被直接预测所取代。先前的工作表明，机器学习模型与结构化电路设计相结合可以在氢系统内跨系统尺寸和结构进行迁移。下一步：将它们扩展到有机分子似乎需要对特定用例的训练集进行重新训练。在这项工作中，我们通过建立炼金术方法证明这是不必要的。几何投影将替代氢原子沿着目标分子的键方向放置，从而将其局部键合环境映射到小的氢碎片上。现有的氢解算器可以按原样重复使用。唯一的新数量是每个键类型的单个投影半径，该半径在小参考分子上安装一次，然后不改变地重复使用。

我们演示了先前工作中使用的可分离对电路设计的方法，并将该方法扩展到跨越量子子空间有效基础的多电路方法。

title: Quantum State Reconstruction from Sklar-Type Relational Data
abstract: Sklar's theorem in classical probability theory rigorously separates the marginal statistics of a joint probability distribution from its dependence structure data. We apply this perspective to the context-dependent classical probability tables induced by the Born rule for a quantum state. For each Born probability table of a given quantum state, we discard the marginal statistics of the individual parties, retaining only the relational data among them. Yet we prove that, when these classical relational data are collected over all contexts, the nontrivial quantum compatibility constraints inherent in quantum mechanics suffice to reconstruct any irreducible multiqubit quantum state itself. This means that the local information of the subsystems, discarded table by table, is fully recovered. We call this quantum-state reconstruction from Sklar-type relational data.
summary: 经典概率论中的 Sklar 定理严格地将联合概率分布的边际统计与其相关结构数据分开。我们将这种观点应用于由量子态的玻恩规则导出的上下文相关的经典概率表。对于给定量子态的每个玻恩概率表，我们丢弃各个部分的边际统计数据，只保留它们之间的关系数据。然而我们证明，当在所有上下文中收集这些经典关系数据时，量子力学固有的重要量子兼容性约束足以重建任何不可约的多量子位量子态本身。这意味着逐表丢弃的子系统本地信息已完全恢复。我们将这种现象称为 Sklar 型关系数据的量子态重建。

title: A Microscopic Model Underpinning Macroscopic QED in Active Media
abstract: We establish a microscopic foundation for macroscopic quantum electrodynamics in active media. Starting from a driven three-level system, we derive an effective two-level description with nonequilibrium stationary populations and employ a quantum central limit approach to obtain collective Langevin dynamics. This construction yields the electromagnetic susceptibility and quantum noise-current correlations from the same microscopic stationary state, providing a direct connection to the reservoir operators of conventional macroscopic quantum electrodynamics. We show that the optical response is governed by the population difference, whereas the noise correlations depend separately on the populations of the two levels. Consequently, at optical transparency, the imaginary part of the susceptibility vanishes while quantum fluctuations remain finite. We interpret the resulting noise statistics in terms of an effective reservoir occupation and a purification involving two vacuum modes, and establish a corresponding effective-temperature fluctuation--dissipation relation. Finally, we demonstrate that the residual fluctuations at transparency can induce finite heating of a nearby quantum probe.
summary:
我们为活性介质中的宏观量子电动力学奠定了微观基础。从驱动的三能级系统开始，我们推导了非平衡静止布居的有效两能级描述，并采用量子中心极限方法来获得集体朗之万动力学。这种结构从相同的微观静止状态产生电磁磁化率和量子噪声电流相关性，为传统宏观量子电动力学的储层算子提供了直接连接。我们表明，光学响应由总体差异决定，而噪声相关性分别取决于两个级别的总体。因此，在光学透明度下，磁化率的虚部消失，而量子涨落仍然有限。我们根据有效的储层占用和涉及两种真空模式的净化来解释所得的噪声统计数据，并建立相应的有效温度波动耗散关系。

最后，我们证明了透明度的残余波动可以引起附近量子探针的有限加热。

title: A geometrical approach for obtaining exact analytical solutions for a scalar field in a one-dimensional dynamical cavity
abstract: The dynamical Casimir effect was first predicted by G. T. Moore in 1969, who considered a real scalar field inside a cavity with a moving mirror in ($1+1$)D, satisfying Dirichlet boundary conditions. Moore wrote the general solution for the field in terms of a function that satisfies a functional equation nowadays known as the Moore this http URL the literature, exact analytical solutions to the Moore equation form a rather small set, restricted to specific classes of laws of motion. Cole and Schieve (1995) developed a geometrical approach that yielded a general formula for the solution of the Moore equation for cavities initially at rest. However, its application has always been done through numerical calculations, and their approach has therefore long been regarded solely as a numerical method. In this work, we show that their method can also be employed as a powerful method for deriving exact analytical solutions, and show the applicability of this approach to deriving analytical solutions to the Moore equation. We obtain original exact analytical solutions for an expanding cavity with a uniformly moving mirror, a contracting cavity with a mirror that approaches the static one asymptotically, and, in addition, we recover the first analytical solution to the Moore equation for a resonant mirror motion, originally obtained by Law in 1994. Moreover, we extend the Cole-Schieve approach, showing that exact solutions can be constructed from any spacetime region where the Moore function has already been determined. We show that this extended geometrical approach allows us to expand the set of known analytical solutions to the Moore equation from the few classes of motion reported in the literature to an infinite set, as it enables the treatment of new classes of laws of motion obtained by combining those presented here with each other as well as with previously known classes of trajectories.
summary:
动态卡西米尔效应最早由 G. T. Moore 于 1969 年预测，他考虑了在 ($1+1$)D 中带有移动镜的腔体内存在实标量场，满足狄利克雷边界条件。摩尔用满足函数方程的函数编写了该领域的通解，该函数现在被称为摩尔这个 http URL 文献，摩尔方程的精确解析解形成了一个相当小的集合，仅限于特定类别的运动定律。 Cole 和 Schieve (1995) 开发了一种几何方法，得出了求解初始静止腔体摩尔方程的通用公式。然而，其应用一直是通过数值计算来完成的，因此他们的方法长期以来被仅仅视为数值方法。在这项工作中，我们表明他们的方法也可以用作导出精确解析解的强大方法，并展示了该方法在导出摩尔方程解析解时的适用性。

我们获得了带有均匀移动镜子的膨胀腔和渐近接近静态镜子的收缩腔的原始精确解析解，此外，我们还恢复了谐振镜运动摩尔方程的第一个解析解，该方程最初由 Law 于 1994 年获得。此外，我们扩展了 Cole-Schieve 方法，表明可以从摩尔函数已确定的任何时空区域构造精确解。我们证明，这种扩展的几何方法使我们能够将摩尔方程的已知解析解集从文献中报道的几类运动扩展到无限集，因为它能够处理通过将此处提出的运动定律相互结合以及与先前已知的轨迹类别相结合而获得的新运动定律类别。

title: Proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis Conjecture: An Exposition
abstract: We give an exposition of a recent proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, which states that every degree-$d$ polynomial $p : \{0,1\}^n \to [0,1]$ has a variable of influence at least $\mathrm{poly}(\mathrm{Var}(p)/d)$. This implies that quantum query algorithms for decision problems can be efficiently simulated classically on most inputs. It also yields a near-equivalence between the status of the $\mathsf{BPP}$ vs. $\mathsf{BQP}$ problem in the random oracle and unrelativized worlds. We organize the proof around four main steps and discuss how each connects to the literature on the analysis of boolean functions and probabilistic combinatorics. To bring out the key ideas, we do not optimize parameters, and our presentation yields weaker exponents than the original. $\textbf{Authors' note.}$ The proof was discovered by David Turturean using a research system developed at Physical Superintelligence (PSI), in combination with a non-public Anthropic model. The proof was then shared with the authors, who worked to understand it and prepare this exposition. Anthropic's public models were used in this process. The authors did not receive financial compensation from Anthropic or PSI. This article is not intended for publication at a conference or in a journal.
summary:
我们给出了 Aaronson-Ambainis 猜想的最新证明，该猜想指出每个 $d$ 次多项式 $p : \{0,1\}^n \to [0,1]$ 至少有一个影响变量 $\mathrm{poly}(\mathrm{Var}(p)/d)$。这意味着决策问题的量子查询算法可以在大多数输入上进行有效的经典模拟。它还在随机预言和非相对化世界中的 $\mathsf{BPP}$ 与 $\mathsf{BQP}$ 问题的状态之间产生近乎等价的结果。我们围绕四个主要步骤组织证明，并讨论每个步骤如何与布尔函数和概率组合分析的文献联系起来。为了阐明关键思想，我们没有优化参数，并且我们的演示产生的指数比原始的要弱。 $\textbf{作者注。}$ 该证明是 David Turturean 使用物理超级智能 (PSI) 开发的研究系统结合非公开的人择模型发现的。然后，该证明与作者分享，他们努力理解它并准备这个阐述。在此过程中使用了 Anthropic 的公共模型。作者没有从 Anthropic 或 PSI 获得经济补偿。

本文不打算在会议或期刊上发表。

title: Pauli propagation in adaptive local frames
abstract: The cost of Pauli propagation depends on the local basis in which the evolving operator is expanded. We show that its Pauli complexity splits into an occupation part, invariant under local rotations and bounded from below by the operator mass and length distributions, and a flavour part that a suitable basis can remove. We introduce frame-adaptive Pauli propagation (FAPP), which rotates the basis of every qubit, gate by gate, to the principal axes of the operator's local polarisation, exactly and within the memory structure of Pauli propagation. This simple rule achieves most of what the best local frame can, and the polarisation predicts how much any local frame can gain. In the Ising chain in transverse and longitudinal fields, FAPP lowers the truncation error at fixed memory by up to an order of magnitude and the memory by a size-independent factor of three; on the infinite two-dimensional lattice it needs up to seven times fewer strings for a given certified accuracy, and in Clifford circuits doped with T gates two to eight times fewer.
summary: 泡利传播的成本取决于演化算子扩展的局部基础。我们证明了它的泡利复杂度分为占据部分，在局部旋转下不变，并由算子质量和长度分布从下面限制，以及适当的基础可以去除的风味部分。我们引入了帧自适应泡利传播（FAPP），它将每个量子位的基础逐个门地旋转到算子局部极化的主轴，精确地并在泡利传播的记忆结构内。这个简单的规则实现了最佳局部帧所能达到的大部分效果，并且极化预测任何局部帧可以获得多少增益。在横向和纵向领域的伊辛链中，FAPP 将固定内存的截断误差降低了一个数量级，并将内存降低了与大小无关的三倍；在无限二维晶格上，达到给定的认证精度所需的串数减少了七倍，而在掺杂 T 门的 Clifford 电路中，串数减少了两到八倍。

title: Advantage Distillation in Paired-State Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: We investigate advantage distillation for paired-state Loop-Back quantum key distribution, with a fixed optical station serving a lightweight portable terminal. Alice prepares two polarization-encoded pulses, Bob selects and applies a polarization filter to each pulse, and Alice infers his selections from the returned detection pattern. The proposed advantage-distillation step selects consistent blocks of three two-bit records using two independent public parity checks on a minimal connected graph. The closing edge of a parity polygon is shown to be redundant: any spanning tree of the same vertices has the same acceptance set. We derive exact acceptance probabilities, residual-error laws, and retention rates. Under independent bit errors, the three-record filter reduces the leading error term from e to e^2, while its cost in discarded records and public information is accounted for explicitly. A modular security theorem bounds the additional guessing advantage available to an adversary after syndrome disclosure and block acceptance, including arbitrary quantum side information. We also evaluate a specified single-photon passive-tap optical channel, obtaining a positive conditional entropy bound and exact accepted-block security quantities. This parity-based advantage-distillation step detects discrepancies by postselection; it does not correct individual errors and is intended to precede conventional reconciliation. The architecture suggests two further directions: hybrid filtering and reconciliation, and key establishment between portable users accessing a shared quantum station.
summary:
我们研究了配对状态环回量子密钥分发的优势蒸馏，其中固定光学站服务于轻型便携式终端。 Alice 准备两个偏振编码脉冲，Bob 选择偏振滤波器并将其应用于每个脉冲，Alice 从返回的检测模式推断他的选择。所提出的优势蒸馏步骤使用最小连通图上的两个独立的公共奇偶校验来选择三个两位记录的一致块。奇偶多边形的闭合边被证明是冗余的：相同顶点的任何生成树都具有相同的接受集。我们得出精确的接受概率、残余误差定律和保留率。在独立位错误下，三记录滤波器将前导错误项从 e 减少到 e^2，同时明确考虑了丢弃记录和公共信息的成本。模块化安全定理限制了对手在综合症披露和区块接受后可用的额外猜测优势，包括任意量子辅助信息。

我们还评估指定的单光子无源分路光通道，获得正条件熵界和精确的接受块安全量。这种基于奇偶性的优势蒸馏步骤通过后选择来检测差异；它不纠正个别错误，旨在先于常规对账。该架构提出了两个进一步的方向：混合过滤和协调，以及访问共享量子站的便携式用户之间的密钥建立。

title: An optimal quantum strategy for the $2$-hat game
abstract: We study the two-player hat game as a two-input, three-output non-local game. We calculate the quantum commuting value and show that it coincides with the quantum one. In particular, we show that \[\omega_{\rm q}(H_2)=\omega_{\mathrm{qc}}(H_2)=\frac{15+\sqrt{33}}{36}\approx 0.576238.\] We achieve the optimal quantum advantage using a shared non-maximally entangled qutrit state. To establish optimality, we exploit the game's symmetry under the dihedral group $D_8$ and apply its representation theory to substantially reduce the complexity of the underlying matrix problem. We also determine the no-signalling value $\omega_{\mathrm{ns}}(H_2)=2/3$.
summary: 我们将两人帽子游戏作为二输入、三输出的非局部游戏来研究。我们计算了量子交换值，并证明它与量子交换值是一致的。特别是，我们证明了 \[\omega_{\rm q}(H_2)=\omega_{\mathrm{qc}}(H_2)=\frac{15+\sqrt{33}}{36}\approx 0.576238。\] 我们使用共享的非最大纠缠 qutrit 态实现了最佳量子优势。为了建立最优性，我们利用二面体群 $D_8$ 下的博弈对称性，并应用其表示理论来大幅降低基础矩阵问题的复杂性。我们还确定无信号值$\omega_{\mathrm{ns}}(H_2)=2/3$。

title: Long-distance quantum secure direct communication with Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill qubits
abstract: The Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) code possesses a lattice periodic structure that enables the effective correction of small displacement errors induced by noise in phase space, which is indispensable for quantum computation. The GKP code was also used to construct a long-distance entanglement channel in quantum repeaters and distribute random keys in quantum key distribution (QKD). Using GKP encoding, we propose a quantum secure direct communication (QSDC) protocol that not only transmits the secret message directly, but also helps protect the safety of communication personnel. The exponential attenuation loss of photons can be overcome by the third-generation quantum repeater. Numerical simulation results demonstrate that secure transmission distance exceeding 1000 km is achievable with a 23 dB squeezing level. Furthermore, we establish a cost-based optimization framework to characterize the trade-off among secure communication distance, secrecy capacity, and repeater resources, enabling optimized repeater deployment and providing a systematic design strategy for scalable quantum repeater architectures. The results demonstrate the potential of combining GKP error correction for long-distance QSDC and quantum networks.
summary:
Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) 码拥有晶格周期结构，能够有效校正相空间噪声引起的微小位移误差，这对于量子计算是必不可少的。 GKP 代码还用于在量子中继器中构建长距离纠缠通道，并在量子密钥分发 (QKD) 中分发随机密钥。利用GKP编码，我们提出了一种量子安全直接通信（QSDC）协议，该协议不仅可以直接传输秘密消息，而且有助于保护通信人员的安全。第三代量子中继器可以克服光子的指数衰减损失。数值模拟结果表明，在23 dB的压缩水平下，可以实现超过1000公里的安全传输距离。此外，我们建立了一个基于成本的优化框架来表征安全通信距离、保密容量和中继器资源之间的权衡，从而实现优化的中继器部署并为可扩展的量子中继器架构提供系统的设计策略。

结果证明了将 GKP 纠错相结合用于长距离 QSDC 和量子网络的潜力。

title: High Rate Quantum Block Turbo Codes
abstract: Quantum Block Turbo Code is an iterative decoding technique for concatenated quantum error correction codes in product form. In this paper, we study new high rate quantum block turbo codes with different constituent codes. We examine the impact of the change of codes parameters and the order of constituent codes on turbo performance.
summary: 量子块 Turbo 码是一种用于乘积形式的级联量子纠错码的迭代解码技术。在本文中，我们研究了具有不同组成码的新型高速量子块turbo码。我们研究了代码参数的变化和组成代码的顺序对 Turbo 性能的影响。

title: Attainable and unattainable quantum precision limits in ultrastrong light--matter coupling
abstract: In this paper, we study the gauge dependence of quantum precision in ultrastrongly coupled light--matter systems. The unitary between gauges carries the coupling $g$, so each truncation defines a different family. The quantum Fisher information traces an exact parabola across frames. Harmonic matter minimizes it at a universal $\theta_\ast=\Omega/(\Omega+\omega)$, set by the matter and cavity frequencies. Only the minimal-coupling bound is attainable. Frames differ by a factor $9.6$ with opposite trends. Diverging virtual-excitation gain at the Dicke point is a gauge artifact and saturates.
summary: 在本文中，我们研究了超强耦合光物质系统中量子精度的规范依赖性。规格之间的酉带有耦合$g$，因此每个截断定义了一个不同的系列。量子费希尔信息在帧之间追踪精确的抛物线。谐波物质在通用 $\theta_\ast=\Omega/(\Omega+\omega)$ 处将其最小化，由物质和腔频率设置。只能达到最小耦合界限。框架相差 9.6 美元，趋势相反。迪克点处的发散虚拟激励增益是规范伪影并且会饱和。

title: Singularising quantum channels preserving kappa-additivity
abstract: We construct quantum channels by averaging unitary shift conjugations with respect to $\kappa$-additive probability measures on measurable abelian groups. The channels act on the duals of operator algebras generated by shifts and bounded measurable multiplication operators. They preserve $\kappa$-additivity of quantum states and admit a weak-$*$ integral representation on this class. If the averaging measure vanishes on singletons, every output state is singular. In the appendix, we also establish the corresponding Fubini's theorem for $\kappa$-additive measures.
summary: 我们通过对可测量阿贝尔群上 $\kappa$ 加性概率测度的酉移位共轭进行平均来构造量子通道。通道作用于由移位和有界可测乘法运算符生成的算子代数的对偶。它们保留了量子态的 $\kappa$-可加性，并承认此类上的弱 $*$ 积分表示。如果平均测量在单例上消失，则每个输出状态都是奇异的。在附录中，我们还建立了相应的$\kappa$-累加测度的富比尼定理。

title: All-to-all connectivity via adiabatic ZZ interactions in a superconducting flux qubit processor
abstract: Scalable superconducting quantum processors would benefit from high qubit connectivity, yet existing architectures connect neighbouring qubits via tunable couplers, which introduce substantial wiring and control overhead. Here, we propose a baseband-driven adiabatic ZZ gate that entangles any selected pair in a register of flux qubits coupled via a common cavity. The qubits stay dc-biased at their flux sweet spot. Strong drives applied selectively through local flux lines, at frequencies far below the qubit transitions, adiabatically tilt the quantization axes and generate an effective longitudinal ZZ interaction. The strength of the coupling is tunable and controlled by the amplitudes and relative phase of the drives rather than by any resonance condition. Numerical simulations give coherent gate errors below $10^{-4}$ over broad ranges of drive frequency, with comparable fidelities for two simultaneous gates in a four-qubit register. The protocol is robust against frequency fluctuations and remains effective even when many qubits are coupled to the cavity.
summary: 可扩展的超导量子处理器将受益于高量子位连接性，但现有架构通过可调谐耦合器连接相邻的量子位，这会带来大量的布线和控制开销。在这里，我们提出了一种基带驱动的绝热 ZZ 门，它将任何选定的对纠缠在通过公共腔耦合的通量量子位寄存器中。量子位在其通量最佳点保持直流偏置。通过局部磁通线选择性地施加强驱动，频率远低于量子位跃迁，绝热地倾斜量化轴并产生有效的纵向 ZZ 相互作用。耦合的强度是可调的，并由驱动器的振幅和相对相位控制，而不是由任何共振条件控制。数值模拟在较宽的驱动频率范围内给出了低于 10^{-4}$ 的相干门误差，并且四量子位寄存器中的两个同步门的保真度相当。该协议对频率波动具有鲁棒性，即使在许多量子位耦合到腔时也仍然有效。

title: Long-Range Ergotropy Transfer with Weakened Boundary-Coupling Spin Chains
abstract: Ergotropy is a key quantity of a quantum battery that measures the maximum extractable energy. When the extraction process is not local, a faithful transfer of ergotropy across distance is necessary. In this work, we investigate such transfer by using spin chains with weakened coupling at the boundaries as mediator. Weakening the coupling at the two boundaries of the chain gives rise to localized edge states allowing high fidelity transfer within given time duration. We found that, for long spin chains, the transferred ergotropy alternates between even and odd number of spins. We explain this parity effect by investigating the chain spectral structure. Furthermore, we consider both the nearest-neighbor and long-range interactions between spin. In both model of interactions, weakening the boundary couplings improves the maximum transferred ergotropy for long spin chain, compared with in the case of conventional uniform chain. Although the long-range interaction reduces the transferred ergotropy, the transfer time is reduced, too, in particular for longer chain. In addition to the total transferred ergotropy, we also investigate the effect of initial states of the sender spin to the transport of the coherent and incoherent components of the total ergotropy, and the average transport efficiency.
summary:
Ergotropy 是量子电池的一个关键量，用于测量最大可提取能量。当提取过程不是局部的时，有必要跨距离忠实地传递各向异性。在这项工作中，我们通过使用边界耦合弱的自旋链作为介体来研究这种转移。削弱链两个边界处的耦合会产生局部边缘状态，从而允许在给定时间内进行高保真度传输。我们发现，对于长自旋链，转移的各向异性在偶数和奇数自旋之间交替。我们通过研究链谱结构来解释这种奇偶效应。此外，我们还考虑自旋之间的最近邻相互作用和远程相互作用。在这两种相互作用模型中，与传统均匀链的情况相比，削弱边界耦合可以提高长自旋链的最大传递各向异性。尽管长程相互作用降低了传递的各向异性，但传递时间也减少了，特别是对于较长的链。

除了总传递的各向异性之外，我们还研究了发送器自旋的初始状态对总的各向异性的相干和非相干分量的传输的影响，以及平均传输效率。

title: Reducing Provers in Distributed Quantum Verification
abstract: In the distributed quantum Merlin-Arthur ($\mathsf{dQMA}$) model introduced by Fraigniaud, Le Gall, Nishimura, and Paz (ITCS 2021), a network of quantum computers verifies a global property with the aid of a quantum proof supplied by an untrusted prover. While the nodes are computationally unbounded, the challenge is to limit proof size and the communication required for verification. In this paper, we consider the model of Hasegawa, Kundu, and Nishimura (PODC 2024), where the proof must be unentangled across nodes, and define its extension to $k$ unentangled provers, denoted by $\mathsf{dQMAS}(k)$. In this setting, we investigate the proof size per node and the communication costs of reducing the number of provers. Our first result reduces the number of provers from $k$ to two, doubling the proof size without additional communication. Moreover, with four additional rounds, we can reduce the number of provers from $k$ to one, using at most three times the original local proof size plus a logarithmic term in the number of nodes. Finally, we establish amplification for perfectly complete protocols. In this regime, a single prover suffices with a constant-factor overhead in our reductions, yielding $\mathsf{dQMAS} = \mathsf{dQMAS}(k)$.
summary:
在 Fraigniaud、Le Gall、Nishimura 和 Paz (ITCS 2021) 提出的分布式量子 Merlin-Arthur ($\mathsf{dQMA}$) 模型中，量子计算机网络借助不受信任的证明者提供的量子证明来验证全局属性。虽然节点在计算上不受限制，但挑战在于限制证明大小和验证所需的通信。在本文中，我们考虑 Hasekawa、Kundu 和 Nishimura (PODC 2024) 的模型，其中证明必须跨节点非纠缠，并将其扩展定义为 $k$ 非纠缠证明者，用 $\mathsf{dQMAS}(k)$ 表示。在这种情况下，我们研究每个节点的证明大小以及减少证明者数量的通信成本。我们的第一个结果将证明者的数量从 $k$ 减少到两个，在无需额外通信的情况下将证明大小加倍。此外，通过额外的四轮，我们可以将证明者的数量从 $k$ 减少到一个，最多使用原始本地证明大小的三倍加上节点数量的对数项。最后，我们建立了完美完整协议的放大。

在这种情况下，单个证明者就足以在我们的归约中以恒定因子开销，产生 $\mathsf{dQMAS} = \mathsf{dQMAS}(k)$。

title: Effective Time Advance of Quantum Clocks under Postselection
abstract: In the familiar twin paradox, the traveling twin ages less than the one who stays behind as a consequence of relativistic time dilation. Here, we show that quantum postselection can effectively reverse this outcome. Using an analytically solvable quantum clock model, we demonstrate that postselection of the center-of-mass motion produces an effective time advance through anomalous weak values, even though every individual motional branch undergoes ordinary time dilation. We extend this analysis to a weak gravitational field and show that an effective time advance can arise even for simple coherent states of the quantum clock motion. We further illustrate this effect using a hydrogen-like atom, revealing how it manifests itself in the atomic wavefunction. Our results demonstrate that quantum interference and postselection can produce an effective time advance beyond conventional relativistic time dilation.
summary: 在我们熟悉的双胞胎悖论中，由于相对论时间膨胀，旅行中的双胞胎比留下来的双胞胎年龄要小。在这里，我们证明量子后选择可以有效地扭转这一结果。使用可分析求解的量子时钟模型，我们证明了质心运动的后选择通过异常弱值产生有效的时间提前，即使每个单独的运动分支都经历普通的时间膨胀。我们将此分析扩展到弱引力场，并表明即使对于量子时钟运动的简单相干态也可以出现有效的时间提前。我们使用类氢原子进一步说明了这种效应，揭示了它如何在原子波函数中表现出来。我们的结果表明，量子干涉和后选择可以产生超越传统相对论时间膨胀的有效时间提前。

title: Quantum Robustness via Sandwiched Rényi Divergences
abstract: If a quantum state is known only approximately, how much can the expectation of an observable change? We answer with the worst-case expectation over all states within a sandwiched Rényi divergence budget of a reference state, for every order $\alpha \in [1/2,\infty]$. Convex duality gives this value as a one-dimensional optimization over a sandwiched Schatten norm, running from a fidelity risk at $\alpha = 1/2$, through the entropic risk at $\alpha = 1$, to a quantum conditional value-at-risk at $\alpha = \infty$. The main result is a classicalization theorem: the quantum problem coincides with the classical one for a probability measure $\omega_\alpha$ on the spectral interval of the observable, constructed from Heinävaara's tracial joint spectral measure and given by Stahl's theorem at $\alpha = 1$. The Hoeffding, Bernstein and Markov--Krein bounds of classical probability thereby apply to the quantum problem, and yield Pinsker-type inequalities with Bernstein-type refinements. The measure $\omega_\alpha$ is the Born measure only at $\alpha = 1/2$; for $\alpha > 1/2$, noncommutativity of the observable with the state strictly lowers its variance below the Born variance, and with it every variance-sensitive bound: a quantum deflation.
summary:
如果量子态仅是近似已知的，那么可观察到的期望会发生多大的变化？对于每个订单 $\alpha \in [1/2,\infty]$，我们以参考状态的夹层 Rényi 散度预算内的所有状态的最坏情况期望来回答。凸对偶性将此值作为夹层 Schatten 范数的一维优化给出，从 $\alpha = 1/2$ 的保真度风险，通过 $\alpha = 1$ 的熵风险，到 $\alpha = \infty$ 的量子条件风险值。主要结果是一个经典化定理：量子问题与可观测光谱区间上的概率测度 $\omega_\alpha$ 的经典问题一致，该概率测度由 Heinävaara 的轨迹联合光谱测度构造而成，并由 $\alpha = 1$ 处的 Stahl 定理给出。因此，经典概率的 Hoeffding、Bernstein 和 Markov-Krein 界限适用于量子问题，并通过 Bernstein 型改进产生 Pinsker 型不等式。

测度 $\omega_\alpha$ 是仅在 $\alpha = 1/2$ 时的玻恩测度；对于 $\alpha > 1/2$，可观测量与状态的不可交换性严格地将其方差降低到玻恩方差以下，并随之而来的每个方差敏感界限：量子紧缩。

title: $\mathsf{EQP}\subseteq\mathsf{IP}$ Does Not Relativize
abstract: We construct a recursive oracle $O$ and a unary language $L\in\mathsf{EQP}^O\setminus(\mathsf{IP}^O\cup\mathsf{PH}^O)$, strengthening the $\mathsf{BQP}$ versus $\mathsf{IP}$ oracle separation of Bouland et al. to exact quantum computation. The separation is based on a variant of the Forrelation problem in which the normalized correlation of one Boolean function with the Fourier transform of another is promised to be exactly $+1/2$ or $-1/2$. The main technical contribution is a repair method that constructs distributions supported on these exact levels while preserving the indistinguishability needed for the $\mathsf{IP}$ and $\mathsf{PH}$ lower bounds. A uniform polynomial-time quantum algorithm distinguishes the two cases with certainty using only three oracle queries.
summary: 我们构造了一个递归预言机$O$和一元语言$L\in\mathsf{EQP}^O\setminus(\mathsf{IP}^O\cup\mathsf{PH}^O)$，加强了Bouland等人的$\mathsf{BQP}$与$\mathsf{IP}$预言机的分离。精确的量子计算。这种分离是基于 Forrelation 问题的一种变体，其中一个布尔函数与另一个布尔函数的傅立叶变换的归一化相关性被保证恰好为 $+1/2$ 或 $-1/2$。主要的技术贡献是一种修复方法，该方法构建在这些精确级别上支持的分布，同时保留 $\mathsf{IP}$ 和 $\mathsf{PH}$ 下界所需的不可区分性。统一的多项式时间量子算法仅使用三个预言机查询就可以确定地区分这两种情况。

title: Self-Energy Construction for Chain Representations of Open Quantum Systems
abstract: We identify the self-energy as the environmental response to the system, which transforms covariantly under shifts of the system--environment cut. For a semi-infinite chain with asymptotically uniform parameters, this transformation admits a fixed point that defines the asymptotic boundary self-energy (BSE), whose spectral density is the Wigner semicircle. A chain-extended BSE exploits the trend of the retained chain, offering improved accuracy in representing the environment. The transformation introduces a pseudo-hyperbolic self-energy distance that is invariant under shifts of the cut, providing a natural geometry for comparing environmental responses. As a demonstration, this geometry enables cut-independent error measure of finite damped-oscillator closures of the chain, distinguishing the closure error from the chain depth error, and offers a more accurate fitting scheme than fitting the time-domain correlation function.
summary: 我们将自能定义为环境对系统的响应，它在系统的变化下协变变化——环境切割。对于具有渐近均匀参数的半无限链，该变换允许定义渐近边界自能（BSE）的不动点，其谱密度为维格纳半圆。链扩展 BSE 利用保留链的趋势，提高了表示环境的准确性。该变换引入了伪双曲自能距离，该距离在切割变化下保持不变，为比较环境响应提供了自然的几何形状。作为演示，该几何结构能够对链的有限阻尼振荡器闭合进行与切割无关的误差测量，将闭合误差与链深度误差区分开来，并提供比拟合时域相关函数更准确的拟合方案。

title: A short proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis Conjecture via the completion framework
abstract: We give a short proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture. If a partial Boolean function $f$ is defined on a $\delta$-fraction of all $n$-bit strings and have quantum query complexity $Q(f)$, then, for every $0<\epsilon<1$, a deterministic algorithm computes $f$ correctly on at least a $1-\epsilon$ fraction of its domain using $O( Q(f)^6 / (\epsilon \delta)^2)$ queries. Our proof uses the completion framework and establishes a more general bound in terms of the classical adversary measure. The only result we use from Turturean's recent proof is a special case of his certificate inequality, for which we provide a self-contained proof. We also derive the stronger variant of the Aaronson-Ambainis Conjecture, the bounded-polynomial influence conjecture, from our main result in the appendix.
summary: 我们给出 Aaronson-Ambainis 猜想的简短证明。如果部分布尔函数 $f$ 定义在所有 $n$ 位字符串的 $\delta$ 部分上，并且量子查询复杂度为 $Q(f)$，则对于每个 $0<\epsilon<1$，确定性算法使用 $O( Q(f)^6 / (\epsilon \delta)^2)$ 查询在其域的至少 $1-\epsilon$ 部分上正确计算 $f$。我们的证明使用完成框架，并根据经典对手度量建立了更一般的界限。我们从 Turturean 最近的证明中使用的唯一结果是他的证书不等式的一个特例，为此我们提供了一个独立的证明。我们还从附录中的主要结果导出了 Aaronson-Ambainis 猜想的更强变体，即有界多项式影响猜想。

title: GARI++: A General-Purpose Decoder for Quantum Error Correction
abstract: We present GARI++, a two-stage decoding pipeline achieving accuracy competitive with the state of the art across surface, bivariate bicycle and color codes without relying on ensembles. The first stage uses GARI, a normalized min-sum decoder with random serial scheduling on the GARI transformed matrix. The second stage decoder is used only for the cases that the first stage does not converge, and the decoder is configurable based on the choice of the QEC code. The first stage pipelines towards the second stage both the residual syndrome and the soft information. GARI++ pipelining is predictive, meaning that GARI++ chooses the first stage iteration outputs which are expected to deliver the best accuracy in the second stage. GARI++ motivates a hybrid FPGA-CPU architecture for real-time decoding. For example, under uniform circuit-level depolarising noise with a physical error rate of 0.001, the FPGA implementation of GARI achieves average latencies per round ranging from $201 ns$ to $11.8\mu s$ for surface code distances between 7 and 25. At the same time, due to the very low weight residuals output by the first stage, the average residual decoding time per round remains near constant and below one microsecond on a single Apple M2 core for surface code distances even up to 51 when using Union-Find and accuracy on par with correlated MWPM.
summary:
我们推出了 GARI++，这是一种两级解码管道，在不依赖集成的情况下，在表面、双变量自行车和颜色代码方面实现了与最先进技术相媲美的精度。第一阶段使用 GARI，这是一种归一化最小和解码器，在 GARI 变换矩阵上进行随机串行调度。第二级解码器仅用于第一级不收敛的情况，并且解码器可基于QEC码的选择进行配置。第一阶段将残余综合症和软信息输送到第二阶段。 GARI++ 流水线是预测性的，这意味着 GARI++ 选择第一阶段的迭代输出，这些输出预计将在第二阶段提供最佳的准确性。 GARI++ 采用混合 FPGA-CPU 架构进行实时解码。例如，在物理错误率为 0.001 的统一电路级去极化噪声下，GARI 的 FPGA 实现每轮的平均延迟范围为 201 ns$ 到 11.8\mu s$（表面代码距离在 7 到 25 之间）。

同时，由于第一阶段输出的权重残差非常低，在单个 Apple M2 内核上，每轮的平均残差解码时间保持接近恒定且低于 1 微秒，当使用 Union-Find 时，表面代码距离甚至高达 51，并且精度与相关 MWPM 相当。

title: The hidden symmetry operators of the asymmetric quantum Rabi model and its two-photon and two-mode variants in closed form
abstract: The asymmetric quantum Rabi model, a two-level system with splitting $\Delta$ and bias $\epsilon$ coupled with strength $g$ to a boson mode, has level crossings when $\epsilon$ is an integer multiple $N$ of the mode frequency. They are due to a hidden symmetry operator $J$, for which no general formula has been available. Here we obtain $J$ in closed form for every $N$. We find that $J$ is given by the parity of the symmetric model times the continuant (ordered tridiagonal determinant) of $N$ first-order operators, which are the Hamiltonians at the intermediate biases $N-1,N-3,\dots,1-N$ minus a common number operator. The symmetry is thus a staircase of $N$ bias steps that closes on the mirror image of the model precisely at integer bias. The proof uses induction on two commutation relations. The same relations hold in the asymmetric two-photon and two-mode models, written with the generators of $\mathfrak{su}(1,1)$, so that the same continuant gives their symmetry operators for every order, previously known only for the lowest ones. We also relate the closed formula for $J$ to the known recursion relations for its coefficients and give their terms of lowest order in $\Delta$ explicitly.
summary:
非对称量子拉比模型是一个两能级系统，具有分裂 $\Delta$ 和偏置 $\epsilon$，加上玻色子模式的强度 $g$，当 $\epsilon$ 是模式频率的整数倍 $N$ 时，会出现能级交叉。它们是由于隐藏的对称运算符 $J$ 造成的，目前还没有可用的通用公式。这里我们为每个 $N$ 获得封闭形式的 $J$。我们发现 $J$ 是由对称模型的奇偶性乘以 $N$ 一阶运算符的连续式（有序三对角行列式）给出的，这些一阶运算符是中间偏差 $N-1,N-3,\dots,1-N$ 处的哈密顿量减去公共数字运算符。因此，对称性是一个由 $N$ 偏差阶跃组成的阶梯，精确地以整数偏差闭合模型的镜像。该证明使用了两个对易关系的归纳法。同样的关系在不对称双光子和双模模型中也成立，用 $\mathfrak{su}(1,1)$ 的生成器编写，因此相同的连续式给出了每个阶的对称算子，以前只知道最低阶的对称算子。

我们还将 $J$ 的封闭公式与其系数的已知递归关系联系起来，并明确给出 $\Delta$ 中它们的最低阶项。

title: Dephasing-Induced Melting of Crystalline Spectral Form Factors
abstract: Long-range spectral order can be probed using spectral form factors, where it manifests itself as sharp Bragg peaks at integer multiples of the Heisenberg time in nearly crystalline spectra. We examine how energy dephasing in open systems affects this spectral order and how to control it. We find that Bragg peaks fade algebraically with revival order and dephasing strength, $K_{\rm Bragg}(p)\propto(\gamma p)^{-1/2}$, within an extensive intermediate regime, and persist up to the lifetime of nearest-neighbor coherences despite an extreme decoherence rate. Our results establish the spectral form factor as a probe of spectral order in open quantum systems and identify temporal correlations in spectral fluctuations as a means of controlling it.
summary: 可以使用光谱形状因子来探测长程光谱级，它在近结晶光谱中表现为海森堡时间整数倍处的尖锐布拉格峰。我们研究开放系统中的能量相移如何影响这种光谱顺序以及如何控制它。我们发现布拉格峰在广泛的中间范围内随着复兴顺序和相干强度 $K_{\rm Bragg}(p)\propto(\gamma p)^{-1/2}$ 以代数方式衰减，并且尽管退相干率极端，但仍持续到最近邻相干性的寿命。我们的结果将光谱形状因子确立为开放量子系统中光谱顺序的探针，并识别光谱波动中的时间相关性作为控制它的手段。
